verses.text: Hadien ka jingïap u Ahab, ki Moab ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki Israel.

Ka la jia ba u Ahasia u la hap na ka khalki jong ka kamra ka bahajrong jong ka ïing jong u kaba ha Samaria, bad u la mynsaw. Kumta u la phah briew, u ong, “Khie leit kylli na u Baal-Zebub, u blei Ekron, lada ngan koit ne em na kane ka jingmynsaw.”

Hynrei u angel u Trai u la ong ha u Elija nong Tishbi, “Khie leit ïakynduh ïa ki nongrah khubor u syiem Samaria, bad ong ïa ki kumne, ‘Hato dei namarba ym don Blei shuh ha Israel mo, me sa leit wad jingtip na u Baal-Zebub, u blei Ekron?’
Namarkata u Trai U ong kumne, ‘Men ym lah shuh ban hiar na ka jynthiah ba me la thiah, pynban men sa ïap da shisha shisha.’ ” Kumta u Elija u la leit.
Kita ki nongrah khubor ki la leit phai sha u syiem, bad u la kylli ïa ki, “Balei phi wan phai noh?”

Kita ki la jubab ïa u, “Uwei u briew u la wan ïakynduh ïa ngi bad u la ong, ‘Leit phai sha u syiem uba la phah ïa phi bad ong ïa u: U Trai U ong kumne, Hato dei namar ba ym don Blei ha Israel ba me sa phah wad jingtip na u Baal-Zebub, u blei Ekron? Namarkata men ym lah shuh ban hiar na ka jynthiah ba me la thiah, pynban men sa ïap da shisha shisha.’ ”
Nangta u la kylli ïa ki. “Uba kumei uta u briew uba la wan ïakynduh ïa phi ban ïathuh ïa kum kine kiei kiei?”
Ki la jubab ïa u, “U la kup ka jaiñ shñiuh, bad u don u panpoh snieh ha ka syngkai.” Hangta u syiem u la ong, “U dei u Elija nong Tishbi!”

Kumta u syiem u la phah uwei u rangbah pyrton bad sanphew ngut ki briew jong u. Une u la leit kiew sha u Elija uba la shong ha kliar uwei u lumrit bad u la ong ha u, “Ko briew u Blei, u syiem u ong, ‘Ale, wan hiar.’ ”

Hynrei u Elija u la jubab ïa u rangbah ki sanphew ngut, “Lada nga dei u briew u Blei, ai ka ding kan wan hiar na bneng bad kan bam duh ïa me bad ïa ki briew jong me baroh sanphew ngut.” Shisha ka ding ka la wan hiar na bneng bad ka la bam duh ïa u bad ïa ki briew jong u baroh sanphew ngut.

U syiem u la phah uwei pat u rangbah pyrton lem bad la ki sanphew ngut ki briew. Une u la leit kiew bad u la ong ha u Elija, “Ko briew u Blei, kane ka long ka hukum u syiem, ‘Ale hiar noh kloi kloi!’ ”

Hynrei u Elija u la jubab ïa ki, “Lada nga long u briew u Blei, ai yn wan hair ka ding na bneng ban bam duh ïa me bad ïa ki briew jong me baroh sanphew ngut.” Markumta ka ding u Blei ka la wan hiar bad ka la bam duh ïa u bad ki briew jong u baroh sanphew ngut.

Ha ka balai sien u syiem u la phah ïa u rangbah pyrton lem bad sanphew ngut ki briew jong u. Uta u rangbah pyrton u balai jong ki sanphew u la leit kiew, bad u tang shu poi, u la dem khohsiew hakhmat u Elija, bad u la kyrpad ïa u, “Ko briew u Blei, nga kyrpad ïa phi, ha pyrkhat lem seh ïa ka jingkordor ka jingim jong nga bad jong kine ki shakri jong phi sanphew ngut!

Hakhmih, ka ding ka la wan hiar na bneng bad ka la bam duh ïa kiwei pat ki rangbah pyrton ar ngut lem bad ki briew jong ki sanphew sanphew ngut. Hynrei to ai ki khmat jong phi kin ñiew burom ïa ka jingim jong nga.”
Te u angel u Trai u la ong ha u Elija, “Khie leit bad u; wat sheptieng ïa u.” Kumta u la ïeng u la leit ryngkat bad u sha u syiem.

U la ong ha u, “U Trai U ong kumne, ‘Namarba me la phah briew ban wad jingtip na u Baal-Zebub, u blei Ekron (hato ym don Blei ha Israel ban wad jingtip na u?), kumta men ym khie shuh na ka jynthiah ba me thiah, bad men sa ïap da shisha.’ ”

Kumta u la ïap katkum ka ktien u Trai Uba la kren da u Elija. Namarba u Ahasia um don khun shynrang, u Jehoram, u para jong u, u la long syiem hadien jong u, ha ka snem ba-ar jong u Jehoram, khun u Jehoshaphat, u syiem Juda.
Ïa kiwei pat ki kam jong u Ahasia la thoh ha ka Kitab Jynthoh kynmaw jong ki Syiem Israel.
Te haba u Trai U la jan ban rah noh sha bneng ïa u Elija ha ka ’erlangthari, u Elija bad u Elisha, ki la mih na Gilgal.

U Elija u la ong ha u Elisha, “Sngewbha sah noh hangne. U Trai U la phah ïa nga shaduh Bethel.” U Elisha u la jubab, “Kumba u Trai U im, bad kumba phi hi phi im, ngan ym ieh noh ïa phi.” Kumta ki la ïaleit sha Bethel.

Te ka kynhun jong ki nongïathuhlypa kiba don ha Bethel ki la wan sha u Elisha bad ki la ong ha u, “Phi tip ba u Trai Un sa rah noh na phi mynta ka sngi ïa u kynrad jong phi?” U la jubab, “Hooid, nga tip; phi, shu sngap jar.”

Te u Elija u la ong ha u, “Ko Elisha, to sah noh hangne, nga kyrpad ïa phi, namar u Trai U la phah ïa nga sha Jerikho.” Hynrei u la jubab, “Kumba u Trai U im, bad kumba phi hi phi im, ngan ym ieh noh ïa phi.” Kumta ki la wan sha Jerikho.

Ka kynhun jong ki nongïathuhlypa kiba don ha Jerikho ki la ïawan sha u Elisha bad ki la ïa-ong ha u, “Phi tip mo ba mynta ka sngi u Trai Un sa rah noh na phi ïa u kynrad jong phi?” U la jubab, “Hooid, nga tip; Phi, shu sngap jar.”

Te nangta u Elija u la ong ha u, “Phi sah noh hangne, nga kyrpad ïa phi, namar u Trai U la phah ïa nga sha Jordan.” Hynrei u la jubab, “Kumba u Trai U im, bad kumba phi hi phi im, ngan ym ieh noh ïa phi.” Kumta ki la ïaleit lang baroh ar ngut.
Sanphew ngut na kine ki nongïathuhlypa ruh ki la ïaleit, bad ki la ïaïeng kham pajih na ki, katba kine ar ngut ki ïeng harud Jordan.
Te u Elija u la shim ïa la ka barandi, u la kli ïa ka, nangta u la shoh ïa ka um. Ka um ka la khlad ar liang haduh ba kine ar ngut kin da ïaid lyngba sha shiliang wah halor ka khyndew ka barkhiang.

Ynda ki la jam sha shiliang, u Elija u la ong Elisha, “To ong ngan leh aïu na ka bynta jong phi, shuwa ba yn shim noh ïa nga na phi.” U Elisha u la jubab, “Nga kyrpad ïa phi ban ai ïa nga ar shah ka mynsiem jong phi.”
Une u la ong, “Phi la pan ïa kaei kaei ka ba-eh. La kumta ruh, lada phi ïohi ïa nga haba rah noh ïa nga na phi, phin sa ïoh ïa kaba phi kwah; lada phim ïohi, phin ym ïoh.”
Katba ki dang ïaïaid bad ka kren artat, ha khmih kawei ka kali ding bad ki kulai ding ki la pynïakhlad ïa kine ar ngut. U Elija u la kiew sha bneng ha ka ’erlangthari.

U Elisha u la ïohi ïa kata bad u la pyrta. “Ko pa jong nga, ko pa jong nga! Phi ko nongïalam ka Israel bad u nongda jong ka!” Bad um ïohi shuh ïa u artat. Kumta u la shim ïa la ki jaiñphong bad u la tar ïa ki ar lyngkhot.
Nangta u la tam ïa ka barandi u Elija ba ka hap, bad u sa leit phai. Ynda poi harud wah Jordan u la ïeng,

u la shim ïa kata ka barandi u Elija kaba la hap, u la tied da ka ïa ka um, u ong artat, “Haei u Trai u Blei u Elija?” Te ynda u la tied ïa ka um, ka um ka la khlad ar liang bad u Elisha u la jam sha shiliang.

Haba ka kynhun jong ki nongïathuhlypa kiba don ha Jerikho ki la ïohi ïa u na sha shiliang ka wah, ki la ïa-ong, “Ka mynsiem u Elija ka la sah ha u Elisha.” Ki la ïawan shaw ïa u, bad ki la nguh ngon haduh khyndew hakhmat jong u.

Nangta ki la ong ha u, “Ki shakri jong phi ki don sanphew ngut ki briew ki bakhlaiñ; sngewbha shah ba kin leit wad ïa u kynrad jong phi. Ka lah ban long ba u Mynsiem u Trai U la rah ïa u bad U la bret ïa u ha lum ne them aïu re aïu.” Hynrei u la jubab, “Wat phah ïa ki.”
Hynrei ynda ki la ïaipynbor ïa u haduh ba un da sngewsalia, u la ong, “To phah.” Kumta ki la phah sanphew ngut ki briew bad ki la wad ïa u lai sngi kynthih khlem da lap.
Ki la wan phai sha u katba u dang sah ha Jerikho, bad u la ong ha ki, “Hato ngam shym la ong ïa phi ban ym leit?”

Te ki briew kiba na kata ka shnong ki la ong ha u Elisha, “Ha peit katno ka jingitynnat kane ka shnong, kumba u kynrad jong nga ruh u ïohi; hynrei ka um te ka bajakhlia bad ka khyndew ruh ka balyngki.”
U la ong, “Ha wan rah ka dabor ka bathymmai bad buh khyndiat ka mluh ha ka.” Kumta ki la wan rah ïa ka ha u.
Te u la leit sha ka umpohliew bad u la bret ïa ka mluh ha ka, u ong artat, “U Trai U ong kumne, Nga la pynkhuid ïa kane ka um; naduh mynta yn ym don jingïap bad ka khyndew kan ym lyngki shuh.”
Kumta kata ka um ka la long ka bakhuid haduh kane ka sngi, katkum ka ktien ba la kren u Elisha.

Nangne u la leit kiew sa sha Bethel. Katba u dang ïaid ha lynti, katto katne ngut ki khynnah rit ki la mih napoh shnong bad ki la kren beiñ ïa u, ki ong, “Khie leit, ei synlen khlieh! Khie leit, ei synlen khlieh!”
Te u la phai wak bad haba u la ïohi ïa ki u la tim ïa ki ha ka kyrteng u Trai. Markumta ar tylli ki dngiem kynthei ki la mih na khlaw bad ki la patar sawphew ar ngut ki khynnah.
Nangta u la leit shaduh lum Karmel bad u sa wan phai sha Samaria.
Ha ka snem ka bakhatphra jong ka jingsynshar u Jehoshaphat syiem Juda, u Jehoram u khun u Ahab u la long syiem Israel ha Samaria, bad u la synshar khat-ar snem.
U la leh bymman hakhmat u Trai, la ym da dei eh kumba leh u kpa bad ka kmie jong u, namar u la pyntwa ïa u rishot u Baal uba u kpa jong u u la tei.
La katta ruh u la snoh ha ka pop u Jeroboam u khun u Nebat kaba la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh bymman. Um shym ieh noh satia ïa ka.
U Mesha syiem Moab u la long u nongri blang, bad man la ka snem u dei ban siew khajna ïa u syiem Israel da ki ’langbrot shispah hajar tylli bad da u shñiuh na ki ’langsohmoh shispah hajar tylli.
Hynrei haba u Ahab u la ïap, u syiem Moab u la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa u syiem Israel.
Kumta u syiem Jehoram u la mih na Samaria ynda u la lum lang ïa ki Israel baroh.

U la phah ktien artat sha u Jehoshaphat syiem Juda, “U syiem Moab u la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga, hato phin wan bad nga ban ïaleh thma ïa ki Moab?” Une u la jubab, “Ngan wan. Nga la kloi kum ma phi, ki paid jong nga ruh kum ki paid jong phi hi, ki kulai jong nga ruh kum ki kulai jong phi hi”
Te u la kylli, “Da kano ka lynti phin wan hiar?” U Jehoram u la jubab, “Da ka lynti na ri kynjah Edom.”
Kumta u syiem Israel u la leit lang bad u syiem Juda bad u syiem Edom. Haba ki la ïaid tawiar hynñiew sngi, ym don um na ka bynta ki pyrton bad ki mrad kit jynkit kiba bud ïa ki.
Hangta u syiem Israel u la ong, “Adur lanot! U Trai U la khot lang ïa kine ki syiem lai ngut ban aiti ïa ki ha ka kti u Moab.”

Te u Jehoshaphat u la kylli, “Hato ym don nongïathuhlypa u Trai hangne ba ngin phah ïa u ban wad jingtip na u Trai?” Uwei na ki shakri u syiem Israel u la jubab, “U Elisha u khun u Shaphat, uba la theh um ha ki kti u Elija, u don hangne.”
U Jehoshaphat u la ong, “Ka ktien jong u Trai ka don bad u.” Kumta u syiem Israel, u Jehoshaphat, bad u syiem Edom ki la leit ïakynduh ïa u.

Te u Elisha u la ong ha u syiem Israel, “Nga donkam aïu ma nga bad phi? Khie leit sha ki nongïathuhlypa u kpa bad ka kmie jong phi keiñ.” Hynrei u syiem Israel u la phai ktien, “Em, dei u Trai Uba la khot lang ïa kine ki syiem lai ngut ban aiti ïa ki ha ka kti ki Moab.”
U Elisha u la jubab, “Kumba u Trai ki paid ïa Uba nga shakri U im, lada ym dei ba nga sngewburom ïa u Jehoshaphat syiem Juda, ngan ym da la peit ne kwah ïohi ïa phi.
Lajar katta wan ïalam u nongtem.” Ynda u nongtem u la tem, ka bor u Trai ka la hiar halor jong u.
Te u la ong, “U Trai U ong kumne, ‘Ngan pyndap da ki pung ïa kane ka kharai um ka barkhiang.’
Naba u Trai U la ong shuh sa kumne, ‘Phin ym ïohi lyer ne slap, hynrei katai ka kharai um kan sa dap da ka um khnang ba ma phi, ki jynri jong phi bad ki mrad jong phi kin ïoh dih.’
Kane ka long kaei kaei ka barit hakhmat u Trai; Un sa ai ruh ïa ki Moab ha ka kti jong phi.
Phin sa jop ïa ki shnong baroh kiba don kut bad ki bakynsai tam; phin sa pynngat ïa ki dieng bha baroh, phin sa pynrngat ïa ki umpohliew baroh bad phin sa pynjot ïa ka khyndew bha baroh da ki maw.”
Ynda mynstep, hamar ka por tyrwa jingkñia, hakhmih ka um ka la wan na phang Edom bad ka ri ka la dap da ka um.
Haba ki Moab ki la ïohsngew ba ki syiem ki la wan hiar thma ïa ki, ki la pynmih ïa ki briew baroh kiba la tbit ban kieng atiar, naduh ki khynnah samla haduh ki tymmen, bad la buh ïa ki ha khap-pud.
Haba ki la khie mynstep bad ka sngi ka la tyngshaiñ halor ka um, ki Moab ki la ïohi ïa ka um mar pyrshah jong ki ba ka saw kum ka snam.
Ki la ïa-ong, “Ka dei ka snam. Ki syiem ki la ïaleh bad ïapynïap para maki. Mynta, ko Moab, ïa ngin ïakynrup!”
Haba ki la poi sha ka dara ki Israel, ki Israel ki la ïeng ïaleh ïa ki Moab haduh ba ki la her ïap. Ki la beh nadien jong ki, bad katba ki nangtur shaphrang katta ki nangpynïap ïa ki Moab.

Ki la pyntwa ïa ki shnong ki thaw, bad man la u briew u la pret maw halor ki khyndew ki babha haduh ba ki la dap tang da ki maw suda. Ki la set dam ïa ki umpohliew baroh, bad ki la pynngat naphang ïa ki dieng bha, khatduh ka la sah satang ka Kir-Hareseth hapoh ki kynroh jong ka. Ki pyrton kawang maw ki la ker tawiar ïa ka bad ki la jop artat.
Haba u syiem Moab u la ïohi ba um lah kyrda shuh, u la ïalam bad u hynñiewspah ngut ki pyrton rah talwar ban tur tyngeh na mar pyrshah u syiem Edom; phewse kim shym lah.

Kumta u u la shim ïa la u khun phrangsngi uba dei ban synshar hadien jong u bad u la thang ïa u kum ka jynkñia halor ka kynroh shnong. Hangta ki Israel ki la kem tieng haduh katta katta; ki la ieh noh ïa u bad ki la leit phai sha la ka ri.

Ka la jia ba ka tnga jong uwei na ki riewdkhot jong ka kynhun ki nongïathuhlypa ka la wan ud ha u Elisha, “U shakri jong phi, u tnga jong nga, u la ïap, bad phi tip ba u shakri jong phi u la long uba tiengburom ïa u Trai. Hynrei u nongshah ram u la wan ring mraw ïa ki khun jong nga ar ngut.”

U Elisha u la kylli ïa ka, “Ngan leh aïu na ka bynta jong phi? Ïathuh ïa nga, phi don aïu ha ïing?” Te ka la jubab, “Ka shakri jong phi kam don ei ei satia ha ïing, hynrei tang shi klong ka umphniang.”
U la ong, “Khie leit ïapan klong kylliang na ki para marjan marpa jong phi – ki klong ki bathylli, katba lah ban ïoh.
Nangta rung hapoh ïing, khang khop ïa lade baroh shi khun, bad sa phylliew ha kine ki klong baroh. Ynda la dap uwei, buh ïa u harud.”
Kumta ka la leit bad ka la khang khop ïa lade bad la ki khun. Katba ki nangrah ïa ki klong, ma ka ka nangphylliew.
Ynda ki klong ki la dap, ka la ong ha u khun jong ka, “Wan rah sa uwei pat u klong.” U la jubab, “Ym don shuh.” Te kumta ka umphniang ruh ka la sangeh ban tuid.
Hadien kata ka la wan ïathuh ïa u briew u Blei, bad uta u la ong, “Khie leit die ïa ka umphniang, bad sa siew ïa ki ram ki shah jong phi. Ma phi bad ki khun jong phi phin sa ïoh bam da kaba tam.”

Ha kawei ka sngi u Elisha u la poi sha Shunem. Ha kata ka shnong la don kawei ka briew ka bariewspah kaba la pynbor ïa u ban bam jynbam. Kumta katba u dei ïaid na kata ka lynti, u shait leit rung hangta ban bam jynbam.
Kane ka la ong ha la u tnga, “Nga ithuh ba une u briew uba shait ïaid na kane ka lynti u long u briew u bakhuid jong u Blei.

To ngin ïathaw kawei ka kamra ka barit halor tnum, ngin da ker kynroh ïa ka bad ngin buh hangta na ka bynta jong u kawei ka jynthiah, ka miej, ka shuki bad ka sharak, khnang ba un ïoh sah hangta haba u wan sha ngi.”
Ha kawei ka sngi u la wan poi hangta bad u la leit shong pynjah thait ha kata ka kamra.
Nangta u la ong ha u Gehazi u shakri jong u, “Khie leit khot ïa ka nong Shunem.” Tang shu khot ïa ka, ka la wan bad ka la ïeng hakhmat jong u.

U Elisha u la ong ha u Gehazi, “Ong ïa ka kumne, ha peit phi la pynshitom ïa lade katne katne na ka bynta jong ngi; hato ngin leh aïu na ka bynta jong phi? Hato phi kwah ba ngin pynkren ei ei na ka bynta jong phi ha u syiem ne u rangbah pyrton?” Ka la phai ktien, “Nga shong hapdeng la ki briew.”
Kham hadien u la ong, “Ngin leh aïu keiñ na ka bynta jong ka?” U Gehazi u la jubab, “Kam don khun, bad u tnga jong ka ruh u la tymmen.”
U la ong, “Khie khot ïa ka.” Ynda u la khot ïa ka, ka la wan bad ka la ïeng ha jynkhang.
Te u la ong, “Kum ha kane ka samoi, ynda poi biang kane ka por, phin sa kdup u khun.” Ka la ong, “Em ko kynrad, ko briew u Blei; wat kren danda ïa ka shakri jong phi.”
Hynrei kata ka briew ka la pun bad ka la kha u khun ha kawei pat ka pyrem, malu mala kat ha kajuh ka por ba u Elisha u la ïathuh ïa ka.
Haba u khun u la kham san, u la leit kai ha kawei ka sngi bad u kpa hapdeng ki nongot.
U la ud ha u kpa, “Ani, ka khlieh jong nga, ka khlieh jong nga!” U kpa u la ong ha u shakri, “Khie leit rah ïa u sha ka kmie.”
Te u la rah joit ïa u bad u la wanlam sha ka kmie jong u; u khynnah u la shong ha pneh ka kmie haduh shiteng sngi, nangta u la ïap.
Kumta ka la leit shaneng bad ka la pynthiah ïa u ha ka jynthiah u briew jong u Blei, ka la khang ïa ka jynkhang bad ka la leit noh.
Nangta ka la khot ïa u tnga jong ka, ka ong, “Phah uwei u shakri bad kawei ka kada ba ngan ïoh leit kloi kloi sha u briew jong u Blei, bad ban wan phai pat.”
U la phai ktien, “Phin leit leh aïu mynta ka sngi sha u? Ym dei u ’nai-thymmai ne ka sabath.” Ka la jubab, “Kam lei lei.”
Nangta ka la teh jin ïa ka kada bad ka la ong ha u shakri, “Pynmareh ïa ka mrad; wat pynsuki ïa ka jingjam kjat haduh ba ngan da ong ïa phi.”

Kumta ka la mih bad ka la wan sha u briew jong u Blei ha u lum Karmel. Haba u briew jong u Blei u la ïohi ïa ka ba ka wan, u la ong ha u Gehazi u shakri jong u, “Ha peit, katai hangtai ka nong Shunem.
Khie leit shaw ïa ka, kylli artat, kumno, phi shait phi koit? U tnga ruh u shait? U khun ruh u shait?” Ka la jubab, “Ngi ïashait.”

Haba ka la poi sha u briew u Blei uba la don ha lum, ka la piam ïa ki kjat jong u. U Gehazi u la wan ban kyndat ïa ka, hynrei u briew u Blei u la ong, “Ieh ïa ka, namar ka don ha ka jingkhuslai ka bakhraw, bad u Trai U la buhrieh ïa kata na nga bad Um shym ïathuh ha nga.”
Te ka la ong, “Hato nga la pan khun na u kynrad jong nga? Hato ngam shym la ong, Wat kren danda ïa nga?”

U la ong ha u Gehazi, “Panpoh ïa la ka syngkai, shim ïa u diengduh jong nga ha ka kti, bad khie leit. Lada phi ïakynduh ïano ïano, wat ai khublei; lada don ba ai khublei ïa phi, wat thie; bad to buh ïa u diengduh jong nga halor u khynnah.”
Te ka kmie uta u khynnah ka la ong, “Kumba u Trai U im, bad kumba ma phi ruh phi im, ngan ym ieh noh ïa phi.” Kumta u la ïeng bad u la bud ïa ka.
U Gehazi u la leit shakhmat bad u la buh ïa u diengduh halor uta u khynnah, hynrei ym don jingsawa ne dak jingim. Kumta u la wan phai ban ïathuh ha u Elisha, “U khynnah um shym kyndit.”
Haba u Elisha u la rung hapoh ïing, u la ïohi ïa u khynnah ba u thiah ïap ha ka jynthiah jong u.
Kumta u la rung bad u la khyrdep ïa ka jynkhang; tang ma ki ar ngut ki ïadon. Nangta u la duwai ha u Trai.

Ynda u la kiew shajrong, u la dem halor ka met uta u khynnah bad u la pyndei ïa la ka shyntur ha ka shyntur jong u, ïa la ki khmat ha ki khmat jong u, ïa la ki kti ha ki kti jong u. Haba u la pyiar ïa lade halor jong u, ka doh u khynnah ka la syaid.
Te u la khie pat bad u la ïaid sharum shaneng hapoh ïing, nangta u la kiew biang bad u la pyiar ïa lade halor jong u. Uta u khynnah u la synriah hynñiew wat bad u la peit ki khmat.
Hangta u Elisha u la khot ïa u Gehazi bad u la ong, “Phah wan ïa ka nong Shunem.” Kumta u la leit khot ïa ka. Ynda ka la wan sha u, u la ong, “Shim ïa la u khun.”
Ka la wan bad ka la dem ngon ha ki kjat jong u, nangta ka la shim ïa la u khun bad ka la mih noh.

Te u Elisha u la wan poi biang ha Gilgal, bad la don ka ’nemsniew ha kata ka thaiñ. Katba ki nongïathuhlypa ki dang ïashong hakhmat jong u, u la ong ha u shakri jong u, “Tiew ïa u khiew heh ban shet syrwa na ka bynta ki dkhot kane ka jingïasyllok.”
Uwei na ki u la leit sha lum ban kheit jhur bad u la lap uwei u jyrmi khlaw, te u la kheit na u shi kynthup ki soh. Ynda wan phai u la ot nuid ïa ki hapoh uta u khiew syrwa, khlem da tip ki dei kiei.
Ki la theh ïa ka ba ki briew kin ïabam. Hynrei katba ki dang ïamad ïa kata ka syrwa jhur, ki la ïapyrta, “Ko briew jong u Blei, don ka jingïap ha une u khiew!” Kumta kim shym treh bam ïa ka.
U la ong, “Ha wan rah moida.” U la ber ïa u ha uta u khiew, bad nangta u la ong, “Theh ba ki briew kin ïabam.” Ym shym don ei ei shuh kaba pynsniew hapoh uta u khiew.

Te la wan poi ha Baal-Shalisha uwei u briew uba wan rah kpu na ki soh nyngkong jong u na ka bynta u briew jong u Blei. La don arphew tylli ki kpu barli bad shi busta u soh kew im. U Elisha u la ong, “Ai ha ki briew ba kin ïabam.”

Hynrei u shakri u la ong, “Kumno keiñ tang katne ngan buh hakhmat shispah ngut ki briew?” Kumta u la ong biang, “Ai la ka ai, ba ki briew kin ïabam; namar u Trai U ong kumne, ‘Kin sa bam, bad kin dang pyntam.’ ”
Kumta u la buh ïa ki hakhmat kita ki briew. Ki la ïabam, bad ki dang pyntam, kumba la ong u Trai.

U Naaman, u rangbah pyrton jong u syiem Siria, u la long u briew uba u kynrad jong u u ñiew burom shibun eh, namar dei da u ba u Trai U la pynlong ba ki Siria kin ïoh jingjop. U la long u ’riewshlur u bakhlaiñ bor, hynrei u pang ’ñiangthohlieh.
Ka la jia ba haba ki Siria ki la leit kurup kyndit, ki la ïoh rong koidi kawei ka samla khynnah na ri Israel, bad ka la long shakri ïa ka tnga u Naaman.
Ka la ong ha la ka kynrad, “Lada u kynrad jong nga un leit pyni ïa lade ha u nongïathuhlypa uba ha Samaria, une un pynkoit ïa u khlem pep na ka jingpang ’ñiangthohlieh.”
Kumta u Naaman u la leit ïathuh ïa u kynrad jong u, “Kawei ka samla kaba na ri Israel ka la ïathuh ïa nga kumta kumta.”
U syiem Siria u la ong, “Khie mynta, ngan phah shithi sha u syiem Israel.” Kumta u la leit bad u la rah bad u shiphew talen ka rupa, shihajar shekel ka ksiar bad shiphew riam ki jaiñ kup.

Te u la rah ruh ïa ka shithi sha u syiem Israel, kaba thoh kumne, “Haba kane ka shithi ka poi sha phi, to tip ba dei ma nga uba la phah sha phi ïa u Naaman u shakri jong nga, ba phin dup pynkoit ïa u na ka jingpang ’ñiangthohlieh.”

Haba u syiem Israel u la pule ïa ka shithi, u la kad ïa la ki jaiñ, u ong artat, “Hato nga dei u Blei ban pynïap bad ban pynim, ba une u briew u phah ktien sha nga hana ban pynkoit ïa u briew uba pang ’ñiangthohlieh? Ha da pyrkhat, peit kumno u wad dong ban ïakajia bad nga.”

Haba u Elisha u briew jong u Blei u la ïohsngew ba u syiem Israel u la kad ïa la ki jaiñ, u la phah ktien sha u syiem u ong, “Balei sha phi kad ïa la ki jaiñ? Phah un wan sha nga mynta ba un dup tip ba don u nongïathuhlypa ha Israel.”
Kumta u Naaman u la wan bad la ki kulai bad ki kali, bad u la sangeh hakhmat jynkhang ka ïing u Elisha.
U Elisha u la phah ïathuh da u briew, “Khie leit sum ha wah Jordan hynñiew sien, bad ka doh jong phi kan sa bha biang, bad phin sa khuid artat.”

Hynrei u Naaman u la leit noh da ka jingbitar, u ong, “Ha peit, nga la nang pyrkhat ba un wan ïakynduh ïa nga, ba un ïeng ban kyrpad ïa ka kyrteng u Trai u Blei jong u, bad ba un kaweh ïa la ka kti halor ka jaka ban pynkoit ïa u bapang ’ñiangthohlieh.
Hato ym kham lah ka Abana bad ka Parper, ki wah Damaskus, ban ïa ki wah Israel baroh? Ym lah ba nga leit sum ha ki ban dup khuid?” Kumta u la leit phai da ka jingingkhong.

Hynrei ki shakri jong u ki la wan hajan bad ki ong, “Ko kpa jong ngi, lada u nongïathuhlypa u la hukum ïa phi ban leh kaei kaei ka bakhraw, hato phin ym treh ban leh ïa kata? Katno lei lei haba u ong ha phi, ‘To sum bad phin sa khuid’?”
Kumta u la leit hiar bad u la pynngam ïa lade hynñiew sien ha ka Jordan, katkum ka ktien u briew jong u Blei. Te ka snieh doh jong u ka la long biang kum ka jong u khunlung, bad u la khuid phar.

Hadien kata u la leit phai bad ka kynhun jong u baroh sha u briew jong u Blei. Ynda u la poi, u la ïeng hakhmat jong u, u ong, “Mynta nga tip ba ym don Blei ha ka pyrthei baroh, hynrei tang ha Israel. Kumta pdiang kane ka jynai burom na u shakri jong phi.”
U Elisha u la jubab, “Kumba u Trai ïa Uba nga shakri U im, ngan ym shim ei ei.” Uta u la pynbor ïa u ban shim, hynrei um treh satia.

Kumta u Naaman u la ong, “Lada phim treh, shah seh, nga kyrpad ïa phi, ba ngan ai ka khyndew ïa u shakri jong phi kat ar kit kada, naba naduh mynta u shakri jong phi un ym tyrwa jingainguh thang ne jingkñia ha uno uno u blei hynrei tang ha u Trai.

Ha kane kawei ka kam to u Trai Un map ïa u shakri jong phi: haba u kynrad jong nga u leit mane ha ka ïingblei u Rimmon, da kaba shaniah ha ka ksangkti jong nga, nga ruh nga dei ban nguh ha ka ïingblei u Rimmon, to u Trai Un map ïa u shakri jong phi ha kane kawei ka kam.”
U Elisha u la ong ha u, “Khie leit suk leit saiñ.” Hynrei haba u Naaman um pat da jngai ba u leit,

U Gehazi, u shakri u Elisha u briew jong u Blei, u la ong, “Peit, u kynrad jong nga u la pyllait ei ïa une u Naaman nong Siria, khlem da shim na ka kti jong u ïa kaba u la wan rah. Kumba u Trai U im, ngan mareh nadien jong u ban ïoh ei ei na u.”
Kumta u Gehazi u la beh nadien u Naaman. Haba u Naaman u la ïohi ba don u briew uba mareh nadien jong u, u la hiar na ka kali ban ïakynduh ïa u, bad u la ong, “Kumno ka bit ka biang baroh?”

U la jubab, “Ka bit ka biang baroh. U kynrad jong nga u phah ong da nga, ‘Dang wan poi myntan sha nga na ri lum Ephraim ar ngut ki samla, na ka jingïasyllok ki nongïathuhlypa; sngewbha seh ai ïa ki mar shi talen ka rupa bad ar riam ki sopti.’ ”

U Naaman u la ong, “Shim ar talen.” U la pynbor ïa u bad u la teh song ïa ka rupa ar talen ha ki muna ar tylli, lem bad ki jaiñkup ar riam, nangta u la pynkit ïa ki ha ki shakri jong u ar ngut ba kin leit rah shakhmat u Gehazi.
Haba u la poi ha lum, u Gehazi u la shim ïa ki jynai na ki kti jong ki, bad u la buh ïa ki ha kawei ka ïing. Nangta u la phah noh ïa kita ki briew, bad ki la leit phai.
Ynda u la poi ha ïing sha u kynrad jong u, u Elisha u la kylli ïa u, “Shano phi la leit, Gehazi?” U la jubab, “U shakri jong phi Um shym leit shano shano.”

Hynrei u Elisha u la phai ktien ha u, “Hato ngam shym leit da ka mynsiem bad phi, mynba uto u briew u la phai na ka kali jong u ban ïakynduh ïa phi? Dei mo kane ka por ban shim sbai bad jaiñkup, brisoh olib bad brisoh waiñ, blang bad masi, shakri shynrang ne kynthei?
Namarkata u ’ñiangthohlieh jong u Naaman un sa bit ha phi bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong phi shi junom.” U Gehazi u la mih nakhmat jong u u bapang ’ñiangthohlieh, la lieh kum ka ïor.
Te ka kynhun ki nongïathuhlypa ki la ong ha u Elisha, “Ha peit, ka jaka ba ngi shong hapoh ka jingsumar jong phi ka khim eh na ka bynta jong ngi.
Shah ngin leit sha Jordan ba ngin ïapom mar uwei uwei u dieng tylli, bad shah ba ngin thaw ïing noh hangta ba ngin shong.” U la jubab, “Khie leit.”
Te uwei u la ong, “Sngewbha seh ban wan ryngkat bad ki shakri jong phi.” U la jubab, “Ngan wan.”
Kumta u la leit lang bad ki. Haba ki la poi ha Jordan, ki la ïapom dieng.
Kumno re kumno katba uwei u dang khet ïa u dieng, u sdie u la hap hapoh um. Kumta u la lynñiar, “Wow kynrad jong nga! U dei uba nga shu ïapan kylliang.”
Kumta u briew jong u Blei u la ong, “Haei u hap?” Ynda u la kdew ha u ïa ka jaka, u Elisha u la pom uwei u diengrit, u la pashat ïa u hangta, bad u nar u la per.
Kumta u la ong, “Shim rah ïa u.” Te uta u la kner ïa la ka kti bad u la shim ïa u.
Shisien haba u syiem Siria u dang ïaleh thma ïa ki Israel u la ïashong pyrkhat bad la ki rangbah ki pyrton ïa kano ka jaka ki dei ban ïaleh.
U briew jong u Blei u la phah ktien sha u syiem Israel, “Da husiar bha ban ym ïaid na kane ka jaka namar ki Siria ki la leit hangta.”

U syiem Israel u la phah pyntip sha kata ka jaka ba u briew jong u Blei u la ïathuh ïa u. Kumta u la ïai maham ïa u syiem bad da kumne u la pyllait im ïa lade ha kata ka jaka ym tang shisien ne arsien.
U syiem Siria u la khuslai jingmut shibun na ka bynta kane kaei kaei, bad u la khot lang ïa ki rangbah pyrton jong u, u kylli, “Ha ïathuh ïa nga uei na phi uba ïashah ïa u syiem Israel?”
Uwei na ki nongbud jong u u la jubab, “Ym don, ko syiem kynrad, hynrei u Elisha, u nongïathuhlypa ha Israel, u la ïathuh ha u syiem Israel ïa ki ktien ba phi kren wat ha la kamra thiah.”
Te u la ong, “Khie peit haei u don, ba ngan ïoh phah kem ïa u.” Haba la ïathuh ïa u ba u Elisha u don ha Dothan,
u la phah shata ki kulai bad ki kali bad u paid pyrton. Ki la wan mynmiet bad ki la kerkut ïa kata ka shnong.

Haba u shakri u briew jong u Blei u la khie dangstep phyrngap bad u la mih shabar, u la ïohi u paid pyrton bad kulai bad kali ba u tawiar ïa kata ka shnong. U shakri u la ong, “Adur lanot, kynrad jong nga! Ngin leh kumno?”
U la ong, “Wat tieng, namar kiba don bad ngi ki kham bun ban ïa kito kiba don bad ki”

Te u Elisha u la duwai bad u la ong, “A Trai, nga kyrpad ïa Me, to pynpeit ïa ki khmat jong u ba un dup ïohi.” Kumta u Trai u la pynpeit ïa ki khmat jong uta u samla bad u la ïohi.” Hakhmih, u lum u dap da ki kulai bad ki kali ding sawdong u Elisha.
Haba ki Siria ki la wan hiar pyrshah ïa u, u la duwai ha u Trai, u ong, “Nga kyrpad ïa Me, pynmatlah ïa une u paid.” Kumta U la pynmatlah ïa ki katkum ka jingkyrpad u Elisha.
U Elisha u la ong ha ki, “Kane kam long ka lynti, kane kam dei ka shnong; shu bud ïa nga, bad ngan ïalam ïa phi sha u briew ba phi wad.” U la ïalam ïa ki sha Samaria.

Ki tang shu rung hapoh Samaria, u Elisha u la ong, “A Trai, pynpeit ïa ki khmat kine ki briew ba kin dup ïohi.” Kumta u Trai U la pynpeit ïa ki khmat jong ki bad ki la ïohi ba ki la don hapdeng Samaria.
Haba u syiem Israel u la ïohi ïa ki u la ong ha u Elisha, “Ko kpa jong nga, ngan pynïap ïa ki? Ngan pynïap ïa ki?”
U la jubab, “Phin ym pynïap ïa ki. Hato phin pynïap da ka waitlam bad ka ryntieh jong phi ïa kiba la kem koidi? Buh kpu buh um hakhmat jong ki ba kin bam kin dih bad kin leit phai sha la u kynrad.”
Kumta u la pynkhreh ka jingkhawai ka bakhraw na ka bynta jong ki. Ynda ki la bam la dih, u la phah noh ïa ki sha la u kynrad. Ki Siria kim shym hiar kurup shuh ïa ka ri Israel.
Ka la jia hadien kane ba u Ben-Hadad syiem Siria u la lum ïa ki paid pyrton jong u baroh bad u la wan ban kerkut ïa ka Samaria.
La don ka ’nemsniew ka bajur ha Samaria ha ka por ba ki kerkut ïa ka. Kawei ka khlieh kada ka shong dor phraphew shekel rupa, bad shi pawa—kab u jyllang khlaw san shekel rupa.
Shisien katba u syiem Israel u dang ïaid na kynroh shnong, kawei ka kynthei ka la pyrta, “Ïarap, ko syiem kynrad jong nga!”
U la jubab, “Lada u Trai Um ïarap ia phi, naei ngan ïoh ban ïarap ïa phi? Na ka kyntem ne ka kor khem umsoh?”

Te u syiem u la kylli ïa ka, “Kaei ka jingjynjar jong phi?” Ka la jubab, “Kane ka briew ka la ong ha nga, ‘Ai ïa u khun jong pha ba ngin ïabam mynta ka sngi, bad ngin ïabam sa ïa u khun jong nga lashai.’
Kumta ngi la shet ïa u khun jong nga bad ngi la bam ïa u. Ha kawei pat ka sngi nga la ong ha ka, ‘Ai sa ïa u khun jong pha ba ngin ïabam,’ hynrei ka la buhrieh ïa la u khun.”
Haba u syiem u la ïohsngew ïa ki ktien jong kata ka briew, u la kad ïa la ki jaiñ—ha kata ka por u dang ïaid na kynroh—bad ki briew baroh ki la ïapeit ba u la phong jaiñ khaiñ hapoh ha ka met.
Te u la ong, “To u Blei Un leh kumta ïa nga bad kham palat shuh, lada ka khlieh u Elisha u khun u Shaphat kan dang sah halor ki tyrpeng jong u mynta ka sngi.”

U Elisha u dang shong ha ïing lajong bad ki tymmen ki san. Hamar kata ka por u syiem u la phah uwei u briew hakhmat. Shuwa ban poi uta u nongrah khubor, u Elisha u la ïathuh ïa ki tymmen ki san, “Ha peit kumno une u nongpynïap briew u la phah khrai ïa ka khlieh jong nga? Peit, tang shu wan u nongrah khubor, khang sbak ïa ka jynkhang bad shan triang ïa ka khlem pyllait ïa u. Ym dei kata ka jingsawa ki kjat u kynrad jong u ba u wan nadien?”
Te katba u dang kren bad ki, u syiem u la wan poi, u ong, “Kane ka jingjynjar ka long na u Trai! Sa katno shuh ngan dang ap ïa u Trai?”

Hynrei u Elisha u la jubab, “To sngap ïa ka ktien u Trai! U Trai U ong kumne, lashai kum ha kane ka por, shi pyrha u ’purew yn die shi shekel, bad ar pyrha u barli yn die shi shekel, ha khyrdop Samaria.”

Te u rangbah pyrton uba btin ïa u syiem u la ong ha u briew jong u Blei, “Wat lada u Trai U thaw jynkhang ïit ha bneng, hato kane ka lah ban long?” Hynrei u la jubab, “Phin sa ïohi da la ki jong ki khmat hynrei phin ym ïoh bam na u.”
Te la don saw ngut ki briew kiba pang ’ñiangthohlieh hamar tyngkong ka khyrdop, bad ki la ïakren para ma ki, “Balei ngin ïashong hangne ban ap ïa ka jingïap?

Lada ngi ïakut ban rung hapoh shnong, ngin ïap hangta namar don ka ’nemsniew ha ka shnong. Lada ngi shong hangne, ngin sa ïap kumjuh. Ale, ïa ngin ïaleit sha ka ktem dara ki Siria. Lada ki pyllait-im ïa ngi te ngi la im, lada ki pynïap ïa ngi te ngin sa ïap.”
Kumta ki la ïamih tang shu kem ïongreiñ ban leit sha ka dara ki Siria, hynrei ynda ki la poi harud ktem dara ki Siria, ym shym don mano mano hangta.

U Trai U la pynïohsngew ha ki pyrton Siria ïa ka jingsawa ki kali bad ki kulai, ïa ka jinghalla u paid pyrton; te ki la ïa-ong para ma ki, “Ha peit, u syiem Israel u la wer bylla ïa ki syiem Hit bad ki syiem Ijipt ban ïaleh ïa ngi.”
Kumta ki la phet ïap haba la kem ïongreiñ: ki la ieh noh ïa la ki ïing jaiñ, ki kulai bad ki kada, baroh kawei ka ktem dara kumba ka long, bad ki la phet ïap phet im.

Haba kine kiba pang ’ñiangthohlieh ki la poi harud ka ktem dara, ki la rung ha kawei ka ïing jaiñ, bad ki la bam la dih, nangta ki la kit ka rupa, ka ksiar bad ki jaiñ, bad ki la leit buhrieh ïa ki. Nangta ki la wan biang, ki la rung sa ha kawei pat ka ïing jaiñ, ki la kit katba ïoh na ka bad ki la leit buhrieh ïa ki.

Nangta ki la ïa-ong para ma ki, “Ngim shym la leh ïa ka badei. Mynta ka dei ka sngi khubor babha. Lada ngi shu sngap bad ngi ap haduh ban da shai mynstep, ka jingpynshitom kan sa lap ïa ngi. Ale mynta ngin leit ïathuh noh ha ïing syiem.”

Kumta ki la ïaleit bad ki la pyrta ïa ki nongap khyrdop shnong, “Ngi la leit poi sha ka ktem dara ki Siria, phewse ym ïohi ne ïohsngew briew ei ei hangta, hynrei tang ki kulai bad ki kada ba shu teh, bad ki ïing jaiñ ki sah kumba ki long.”
Kumta ki nongap khyrdop ki la pyrta bad ki la leit ïathuh ha ïing syiem.

U syiem u la khie dang synñia, bad u la ong ha ki shakri jong u. “Ngan ïathuh ha phi kaei ka jingpyn-ap ki Siria pyrshah ïa ngi. Ki tip ba ngi thngan, namarkata ki la leit noh na ktem dara ban rieh ha lum ha wah, ki pyrkhat kumne, ‘Ynda ki mih napoh shnong, ngin sa kem im ïa ki bad ngin sa rung hapoh shnong.’ ”
Uwei na ki rangbah jong u u la ong, “Phah briew bad san tylli ki kulai kiba dang sah—namar kito kiba dang sah hangne kin long kum ki paid Israel kiba la ïap. To ngin phah peit.”
Kumta ki la shim ar ngut ki shipai shong kulai bad u syiem u la phah ïa ki ban bud nadien ki pyrton Siria, u bthah artat, “Khie leit ban peit.”

Kumta ki la leit nadien jong ki haduh Jordan. Baroh shi lynter lynti la phriang da ki jaiñ bad ki tiar kiba ki Siria ki la pret ha ka jingkyrkieh. Ki nongrah khubor ki la wan phai ban ïathuh ïa u syiem.
Te ki paidbah ki la ïamih ban kurup ïa ka ktem dara ki Siria. Kumta ïa u ’purew ni la die shi shekel shi pyrha bad ïa u barli shi shekel ar pyrha, katkum ka ktien u Trai.

U syiem u la thung ïa u rangbah pyrton, ha uba u la shaniah ha ka ksangkti jong u, ban long nongpeit ha khyrdop shnong, hynrei ki paidbah ki la kum ïuh ïa u bad u ïap ha khyrdop, kumba u briew jong u Blei u la lah ong mynba u syiem u la leit ïakynduh ïa u.
Ka la jia ba haba u briew jong u Blei u la ïathuh ïa u syiem, “Ar pyrha u barli yn sa die shi shekel, shi pyrha u ’purew ni shi shekel, kum ha kane ka por lashai ha khyrdop Samaria,”

utei u rangbah pyrton u la jubab kylliang ïa u briew u Blei, “Wat lada u Trai Un plie jynkhang ïit ha bneng, hato kata ka lah ma ban long?” Te u la jubab, “Phin sa ïohi da la ki jong ki khmat, hynrei phin ym ïoh bam na u.”
Ka la jia kumta ruh ïa u, namar ki paidbah ki la kum ïuh ïa u ha khyrdop shnong bad u la ïap.

Te u Elisha u la ong ha ka kynthei kaba don u khun ba u la pynim biang, ‘Ïeng, khie leit baroh shi ïing shano shano ba phi ïoh jaka ban shong, namar u Trai U la rai ban wanlam ka ’nemsniew, bad kan neh ha ka ri kumba hynñiew snem.”
Kumta kata ka kynthei ka la ïeng bad ka la leh katkum ka ktien u briew jong u Blei. Ka la leit lang bad kiba ha ïing ha sem bad ka la shong ha ka ri ki Philistia hynñiew snem.
Ynda kut ki hynñiew snem, haba kata ka kynthei ka la wan phai na ka ri Philistia, ka la leit kyrpad ïa u syiem ban ïoh biang ïa ka ïing bad ka khyndew jong ka.
Ka la jia ba u syiem u dang ïakren bad u Gehazi u shakri u briew jong u Blei, u ong, “Ha ïathuh ïa nga ïa ki kam bakhraw baroh ba u Elisha u la leh.”

Katba u dang ïathuh ïa u syiem kumno u Elisha u la pynim biang ïa uba la ïap, ka kynthei kaba don u khun ba u la pynim biang ka la kyrpad ïa u syiem ban ïoh biang ïa la ka ïing bad ka khyndew. Te u Gehazi u la ong, “Ko syiem kynrad jong nga, kane hangne kata ka kynthei, une hangne u khun jong ka ïa uba u Elisha u la pynim biang .”

Haba u syiem u la kylli ïa kata ka kynthei, ka la ïathuh ïa u. Kumta u syiem u la thung uwei u rangbah na ka bynta jong ka, u ong, “To pynphai biang ïa kata baroh kaba dei ka jong ka, lem bad ki jingmih na ki lyngkha naduh ka sngi ba ka la phet na ka ri haduh mynta.”
Ka la jia ba u Elisha u la poi sha Damaskus bad u Ben-Hadad syiem Siria u la pang ha kata ka por. Haba la ïathuh ïa u ba u briew jong u Blei u la wan hangta,
u syiem u la ong ha u Hazael, “Rah kawei ka jynai sngewbha bad phi, nangta leit ïakynduh ïa u briew jong u Blei ba un wad jingtip na u Trai. Kylli ïa u, ‘Hato ngan koit ne em na kane ka jingpang?’ ”

Kumta u Hazael u la leit ïashem ïa u. U la rah jynai sngewbha ïa u da ki mar Damaskus kiba har rukom, jin sawphew kit ut. Ynda u la poi hakhmat jong u, u la ong, “U khun jong phi u Ben-Hadad syiem Siria u la phah ïa nga ban kylli ïa phi, “Hato ngan koit ne em na kane ka jingpang?’ ”
Te u Elisha u la ong ha u, “Khie leit ïathuh ïa u, ‘Phin sa koit da shisha. Hynrei u Trai U la pyni ha nga ba ma u da shisha un sa ïap.’ ”
Te u la peit pyn-eh bad u la peit seh ïa u, haduh ba u la sngewrem. U briew jong u Blei pat u la ïam.

U Hazael u la ong, “Balei u kynrad jong nga u ïam?” U la jubab, “Namar nga tip ïa ka jingjynjar ba phin sa wanlam ha ki paid Israel. Phin sa wiang ding ïa ki kut jong ki, phin sa pynïap ïa ki samla jong ki da ka waitlam, phin sa lynthaw ïa ki khunlung jong ki haban da lwet, bad phin sa tar ar liang ïa ki kynthei kiba ar met.”
Te u Hazael u la phai ktien, “Kumno keiñ u shakri jong phi, uba long tang u ksew, un leh kat kane kaei kaei ka bakhraw?” U Elisha u la jubab, “U Trai U la pyni ha nga ba phin sa long u syiem Siria.”

Hadien kata u Hazael u la leit noh na u Elisha. Ynda u la wan sha u kynrad jong u, u Ben-Hadad u la kylli ïa u, “U Elisha u ong kumno ïa phi?” U la jubab, “U la ïathuh ïa nga ba phin sa koit da shisha.”
Hynrei kum lashai u Hazael u la shim ïa ka jaiñ tap thiah, u la wieh ïa ka ha um bad u la tap da ka ïa ka khmat jong u syiem haduh ba un da ïap. Te u Hazael u la long syiem hadien jong u.
Ha ka snem ka basan jong ka jingsynshar u Joram khun u Ahab, syiem Israel, u Jehoram u khun u Jehoshaphat, syiem Juda, u la sdang ban synshar.
U la don laiphew ar snem ka ryta haba u la long syiem bad u la synshar phra snem ha Jerusalem.
U la im pathar kumba ju leh ki syiem Israel, kumba la leh kiba ha ïing u Ahab, namar u la ïapoikha bad ka khun u Ahab. U la leh bymman hakhmat u Trai.
Hynrei u Trai Um shym pynjot ïa ka Juda, U da kynmaw ïa u Dabid u shakri jong U, bad ïa ka jingkular ban ai nongmih bteng ha u bad ha ki khun jong u junom.
Ha ki sngi jong u Jehoram, ka Edom ka la ïaleh pyrshah ban lait na ka jingsynshar ki Juda, bad ka la thung la u jong u syiem.

Ynda kumta u Jehoram u la leit sha Zair bad ki kali jong u. Da kaba khie mynmiet, ma u bad ki rangbah pyrton kali jong u, ki la lait na ki Edom kiba ker tawiar ïa u; ki pyrton jong u ki la phet sha la ïing.
Kumta ka Edom ka la lait na ka jingsynshar ki Juda haduh kane ka sngi. Ka Libna ruh ka la ïaleh pyrshah ha kajuh ka por.
Ïa kiwei pat ki kam u Jehoram, bad ïa ki jingleh jong u baroh, la thoh ha ka Kitab Jynthoh kynmaw ki Syiem Juda.
Kumta u Jehoram u la thiah bad ki kpa jong u, bad ïa u la tep bad ki kpa jong u ha ka Nongbah u Dabid. U khun jong u Ahasia u la synshar hadien jong u.
Ha ka snem ka bakhat-ar jong ka jingsynshar u Joram u khun u Ahab syiem Israel, u Ahazia u khun u Jehoram, syiem Juda, u la sdang ban synshar.
U Ahazia u la don arphew ar snem ka ryta mynba u la sdang ban synshar bad u la synshar shi snem ha Jerusalem. Ka kmie jong u ka kyrteng ka Athalia. Ka la long ka khun ksiew u Omri syiem Israel.
U Ahazia ruh u la im lyngkar kumba leh kiba ha ïing u Ahab, bad u la leh bymman hakhmat u Trai kumba la leh ma ki, namar u la long u pyrsa kurim ha ka ïing ka sem u Ahab.
U Ahazia u la leit ïaleh thma lang bad u Joram u khun u Ahab pyrshah u Hazael syiem Siria ha Ramoth-Gilead, bad ki Siria ki la pynmynsaw ïa u Joram.

U syiem Joram u la wan phai sha Jezreel ban phah sumar ïa ki jynmong ba u la ïoh na ki Siria ha Rama, mynba u la ïaleh thma ïa u Hazael syiem Siria. U Ahazia u khun u Jehoram u la leit hiar ban peit ïa u Joram u khun u Ahab ha Jezreel namarba u pang.

Te u Elisha nongïathuhlypa u la khot ïa uwei na ka jingïasyllok jong ki nongïathuhlypa bad u la ong ha u, “Panpoh ïa la ka syngkai, bad shim ïa une u khiew umphniang ha ka kti, nangta khie leit sha Ramoth-Gilead.
Phi tang shu poi, wad ïa u Jehu khun u Jehoshaphat u khun u Nimshi, nangta leit hapoh ïing bad phah ïeng ïa u napdeng ki paralok, bad sa ïalam ïa u sha ka kamra bashapoh eh.

Hadien kata shim ïa u khiew umphniang, bad theh ïa ka halor ka khlieh jong u, da ong artat, ‘U Trai U ong kumne, Nga pynsleh syiem ïa phi halor ki Israel.’ Nangta plie ïa ka jynkhang bad phet bak; wat pyntud.”
Kumta uta u nongïathuhlypa samla u la leit sha Ramoth-Gilead.

Haba u la poi, ki rangbah pyrton ki dang ïashong dorbar. Kumta uta u la ong, “Nga don ka khubor na ka bynta jong phi, ko rangbah pyrton.” U Jehu u la kylli, “Ïano na ngi?” U la jubab, “Ïa phi, ko rangbah pyrton.”

Kumta u la ïeng bad u la leit shapoh ïing, bad uta u samla u la theh ïa ka umphniang halor ka khlieh jong u, u ong artat, “U Trai u Blei ki Israel U ong kumne, ‘Nga pynsleh syiem ïa phi halor u paid u Trai, halor ki Israel.
Phin sa pynjot thiaw ïa ka ïing u Ahab u kynrad jong phi, ba Ngan dup pynhiar kput ïa ka Jezebel na ka bynta ka snam ki shakri jong Nga ki nongïathuhlypa bad ki shakri baroh jong u Trai.
Kiba ha ïing baroh jong u Ahab ki dei ban ïap. Ngan pom ïa u kynja shynrang baroh uba ïadei jingdei bad u Ahab, lada u dei u mraw ne u balaitluid ha Israel.
Ngan pynlong ïa ka ïing u Ahab kum ïa ka ïing u Jeroboam u khun u Nebat, kum ïa ka ïing u Baasha u khun u Ahija.
Ki ksew kin sa bam ïa ka Jezebel ha ka khyndew Jezreel, bad yn ym don ba tep ïa ka.’ ” Hadien kata u la plie ïa ka jynkhang bad u la phet bak.

Haba u Jehu u la wan phai shaba don ki rangbah pyrton u kynrad jong u, ki la kylli ïa u, “La jia aïu? Balei uto u lamwir u la wan sha phi?” U la ïathuh ïa ki, “Phi tip ïa uto u briew bad ïa ka jingkren jong u.”
Te ki la ïa-ong. “Em ngim tip, ïathuh kat kaba la jia.” U la ong, ‘U la ïathuh ha nga kane katai, hana, ‘U Trai U ong kumne, Nga pynsleh syiem ïa phi halor ki Israel.’ ”
Te man la u briew u la shim kyrkieh ïa la ka jaiñkup bad u la siang ïa ki hapoh u Jehu ha tbian halor ki mawkyrdon. Nangta ki la put ïa ka turoi bad ki la pyrta, “U Jehu u long syiem!”
Hangta u Jehu u khun u Jehoshaphat khun u Nimshi u la sylla pyrshah ïa u Joram. (Ha kata ka por u Joram bad ki Israel ki ïa-ap karod ha Ramoth-Gilead pyrshah ïa u Hazael syiem Siria.

Hynrei u syiem Joram u la leit phai sha Jezreel ban phah sumar ïa ka jynmong ba la pynmynsaw ki Siria haba u la ïaleh pyrshah ïa u Hazael syiem Siria.) Kumta u Jehu u la ong, “Lada phi ïashah bad nga, peit ban ym don ba mih lyndet na shnong ïoh ki leit ïathuh ha Jezreel.”
Te u Jehu u la kiew ha ka kali bad u la leit sha Jezreel, namar u Joram u thiah hangta. U Ahazia syiem Juda u la wan peit ïa u Joram.

U nongap phira uba ïeng halor ka kut Jezreel u la ïohi ka kynhun u Jehu ba ka wan, bad u la ong, “Nga ïohi kawei ka kynhun.” U Joram u la ong, “Phah uwei u nongshong kulai ban leit ïakynduh ïa ki, bad phah ong, ‘Phi wanlam jingsuk?’”

Kumta uwei u nongshong kulai u la leit tan ïa u, u ong, “U syiem u kylli, ‘Phi wanlam jingsuk.’ ” U Jehu u la jubab, “Phin leh aïu ïa ka jingsuk? Khie shadien jong nga.” Te u nongap phira u la leit ïathuh, “U nongrah khubor u la poi sha ki, hynrei um shym wan phai shuh.”

Nangta u Joram u la phah ïa u nongshong kulai u ba-ar bad u la leit sha ki, u ong, “U syiem u kylli, ‘Hato phi wan da ka jingsuk jingsaiñ mo seh?’ ” U Jehu u la jubab, “Phin leh aïu ïa ka jingsuk? Khie shadien jong nga.”
Sa shisien u nongap phira u la leit ïathuh, ‘U la poi ha ki, hynrei um wan phai shuh. Ka rukom ñiah la kum ka jingñiah u Jehu u khun u Nimshi, namar u ñiah dom.”

U Joram u la ai hukum, “Pynkhreh.” Te ki la pynkhreh ïa ka kali jong u. Kumta u Joram syiem Israel bad u Ahazia syiem Juda ki la ïamih, mar la ka kali, ban leit tan ïa u Jehu bad ki la ïakynduh ïa u ha ka khyndew u Noboth nong Jezreel.

Haba u Joram u la ïohi ïa u Jehu, u la ong, “Hato phi wan da ka jingsuk jingsaiñ mo, Jehu?” U la phai ktien, “Yn don jingsuk aïu, katba dang jyllei ki kam nuti bad ki kam byrtong, ka Jezebel ka kmie jong me?”
Hangta u Joram u la pynphai ïa ka kali bad u la phet, u ong artat ha u Ahazia, “Ka jingshet kylla, ko Ahazia!”
U Jehu u la wiat ïa la ka ryntieh katba don ka bor, bad u la siat ïa u Joram napdeng tyrpeng. U khnam u la pei haduh klong snam, bad u syiem u la kyllon ha la ka kali.

U Jehu u la ong ha u Bidkar u rangbah pyrton jong u, “Shim bret ïa u ha ka kper u Naboth nong Jezreel. Phi dang kynmaw ba haba ngi ïashong kulai ryngkat nadien nadien u Ahab u kpa jong u, kumno u Trai U la kynnoh ka rai halor jong u kumne:

‘Thik kumba Nga la ïohi mynhynnin ïa ka snam u Naboth bad ïa ka snam ki khun jong u—u Trai U ong—Ngan sa ai ka nongkylliang ïa me ha kane hi ka kper.’ Namarkata khie shim bret ïa u mynta ha kane ka kper katkum ka ktien u Trai.”

Haba u Ahazia syiem Juda u la ïohi ïa kane, u la phet shaphang Beth-hagan. U Jehu u la beh nadien jong u, bad u la ong, “Siat ïa u ruh.” Ki la siat ïa u ha ka kali ha thiep Gur, kaba hajan Ibleam. U la phet shaduh Megiddo bad u la ïap hangta.
Ki nongbud jong u ki la kit ïa u ha ka kali sha Jerusalem bad ki la tep ïa u ha ka jyntep jong u bad ki kpa jong u ha ka Nongbah u Dabid.
U Ahazia u la sdang ban synshar ha Juda ha ka snem ka bakhatwei jong ka jingsynshar u Joram u khun u Ahab.
Haba u Jehu u la wan sha Jezreel, ka Jezebel ka la ïohsngew ïa kata, kumta ka la tah rong ïa la ki khmat, ka la sad pynbhabriew ïa la ka khlieh, bad ka la phngoid na khalki.
Katba u Jehu u dang rung ha khyrdop, ka la ong, “Hato me wan da ka jingsuk jingsaiñ, ko Zimri, nongpynïap ïa la u kynrad?”
U la khmied ïa la ka khmat sha kata ka khalki, bad u la ong, “Mano ba ïashah bad nga? Mano?” Ar ne lai ngut ki ïunok ki la ïapeit arsut sha u.
U la ong, “Pret ïa ka shapoh.” Kumta ki la pret ïa ka shapoh. Ka snam jong ka ka la pashait sha kynroh bad sha ki kulai bad u Jehu u la pynïaid da ka kali halor jong ka.
Ynda u la leit rung shapoh, u la bam la dih, bad u la ong, “Sa ïapeit mynta ïa kane ka kynthei ba la tim bad sa ïatep ïa ka, namar ka dei ka khun syiem.”
Hynrei haba ki la leit ban tep ïa ka, kim lap ei ei shuh lait tang ka shynrong khlieh, ki kjat bad ki sla kti jong ka.

Ynda ki la wan phai ban ïathuh ha u, u la ong, “Kane ka long ka ktien u Trai, ïa kaba la lah kren da u shakri jong u u Elija nong Tishbi, ‘Ha ka ilaka Jezreel ki ksew kin sa bam ïa ka doh jong ka Jezebel.
Ka met ïap ka Jezebel kan sa long kum ka eit mrad ha lyngkha ha ka ilaka Jezreel, haduh ba yn ym don ba lah ban ong, Kane ka dei ka Jezebel.’ ”

U Ahab u la don hynñiewphew ngut ki khun ha Samaria. Kumta u Jehu u la thoh shithi bad u la phah ïa ki sha Samaria, sha ki nongsynshar shnong, sha ki tymmen ki san, sha ki nongsumar ïa ki khun u Ahab, u ong,
“Te mynta phi tang shu ïoh ïa kane ka shithi, namarba ki khun u kynrad jong phi ki don bad phi, bad phi don ruh ki kali bad ki kulai, bad ki shnong ba la ker kynroh bad ki tiar thma,
to ïajied hi uwei u babha tam bad u bakynsai tam napdeng ki khun u kynrad jong phi, bad sa pynshong ïa u halor ka khet u kpa jong u, nangta sa ïaleh thma na ka bynta ka ïing u kynrad jong phi.”
Ki la tieng raimaw raidieng, bad ki la ong, “Ar ngut ki syiem kim shym lah ban ïashan hakhmat jong u, katno lei lei sa ma ngi?”

Kumta u rangbah ka ïing syiem bad u sordar kata ka shnong, lem bad ki tymmen ki san bad ki nongsumar ki la phah ktien sha u Jehu, ki ong, “Ngi long ki shakri jong phi, bad ngin leh katba phi hukum ïa ngi. Ngin ym thung syiem ïano ïano. To leh katba idei ma phi.

Te u la thoh sa kawei pat ka shithi, u ong, “Lada phi long ha ka liang jong nga, bad lada phi kloi ban kohnguh ïa nga, wan rah ïa ki khlieh jong ki khun u kynrad jong phi ha Jezreel lashai kum ha kane ka por.” Ki khun u syiem, hynñiewphew ngut, ki la ïadon lang bad ki rangbah kata ka shnong, kiba dei sumar ïa ki.

Haba kane ka shithi ka la poi ha ki, ki la shim ïa ki khun u syiem bad ki la pynïap ïa ki, baroh hynñiewphew ngut. Nangta ki la thep ïa ki khlieh jong ki ha ki shang bad ki la phah ïa ki sha u Jehu ha Jezreel.
Haba u nongrah khubor u la wan ïathuh ïa u, “Ki la wan rah ïa ki khlieh jong ki khun u syiem,” u la ong, “Buh ïa ki ar kynton hakhmat khyrdop shnong haduh ynda mynstep.”

Te haba u la mih shabar mynstep, u la ïeng bad u la ong ha u paid baroh, “Phi phim kit pop ei ei. Dei ma nga keiñ uba la sylla pyrshah ïa u kynrad jong nga, bad uba la pynïap ïa u. Hynrei mano ba la pynïap ïa kine baroh?
To tip ba wat kawei ka ktien ba u Trai U la kren shaphang ka ïing u Ahab kan nym long lehnoh-ei. U Trai U la pyndep ïa kata kaba U la kren da u shakri jong U u Elija.”

Kumta u Jehu u la pynïap ïa kito baroh kiba dang sah na ka ïing u Ahab ha Jezreel, wat ïa ki ’riewheh ’riewhaiñ jong u, ïa ki lok ki jor jong u, bad ïa ki lyngdoh jong u baroh lin, haduh ba um shym pynsah im shuh uwei ruh.
Te u Jehu u la mih ban leit sha Samaria. Katba u dang leit, haba u la poi ha Beth-Eked jong ki Nongap langbrot,

u Jehu u la ïakynduh ïa ki kur ki jait u Ahazia syiem Juda, bad u la kylli, “Phi dei kiei?” Te ki la jubab, “Ngi dei ki kur u Ahazia, bad ngi la wan peit ïa ki khun u syiem bad ïa ki khun ka mahadei.”
U la ong, “Kem im ïa ki.” Ki la kem im ïa ki, bad ki la pynïap ïa ki ha ka thliew kaba ha Beth-Eked, sawphew ar ngut, bad um shym pyllait uwei ruh.

Te haba u la mih nangta u la ïakynduh ïa u Jehonadab u khun u Rekhab uba wan tan ïa u. U la ai khublei ïa u bad u la ong ha u, “Hato phi ieid shida ïa nga kumba ieid ma nga ïa phi?” U Jehonadab u la jubab, “Hooid keiñ.” U Jehu u la ong, “Lada kumta, ai ha nga ïa ka kti jong phi.” Kumta u la ai ha u ïa la ka kti. U Jehu u la kyntiew ïa u ha ka kali.
U la ong, “Ale bad nga bad peit ïa ka jingshitrhem jong nga na ka bynta u Trai.” Kumta u la pynshong ïa u ha la ka kali.
Ynda u la poi ha Samaria, u la pynïap ïa ki kur u Ahab baroh kiba dang im ha Samaria, haduh ba ki da lut phoiñ, katkum ka ktien u Trai kaba U la kren ha u Elija.
Te u Jehu u la lum lang ïa u paid baroh bad u la ong ha ki, “U Ahab u la shakri khyndiat ïa u Baal, hynrei u Jehu un shakri ïa u shibun.

Namarkata khot mynta shane sha nga ïa ki nongïathuhlypa baroh jong u Baal, ïa ki ’riewngeit jong u baroh bad ïa ki lyngdoh jong u baroh. Ym dei ban jah mano kano namar nga dei ban tyrwa ka jynkñia ka bakhraw ha u Baal. Uno uno uba jah un ym im.” Hynrei u Jehu u la leh sian khnang ban pynïap ïa ki ’riewngeit baroh jong u Baal.
U Jehu u la hukum, “Pynban ban long ka jingïalang ka bakhuid na ka bynta u Baal.” Kumta ki la pynbna ïa ka.

Te u Jehu u la phah ktien baroh shi Israel bad ki ’riewngeit u Baal ki la ïawan baroh, haduh ba ym don shuh uba khlem wan. Ki la ïarung hapoh ka tempyl u Baal, bad ka duwan u Baal ka la dap smam na bakut ha bakut.
U la hukum ïa u nongsumar ki jaiñ lehniam, “Sei lut ïa ki jaiñ lehniam na ka bynta ki nongmane baroh jong u Baal.” Kumta u la wanlam ïa ki jaiñ lehniam na ka bynta jong ki.

U Jehu u la rung hapoh ka ïing u Baal ryngkat bad u Jehonadab u khun u Rekhab, bad u la ong ha ki ’riewngeit u Baal, “Wad bad peit thuh ba ym dei ban don shakri u Trai hapdeng jong phi, hynrei tang ki nongmane u Baal.”

Hadien kata u la leit tyrwa jynkñia bad jyntyrwa thang. U Jehu u la buh briew shabar phraphew ngut, u ong artat, “Lada uno uno na phi u pyllait wat ïa uwei na kine kiba nga phah ap, un sa kut la ka jingim.”

Kumta u tang shu dep kaba tyrwa jynkñia thang, u Jehu u la hukum ïa ki nongap bad ïa ki rangbah, “Khie rung bad pynïap ïa ki, wat pyllait im uwei ruh.” Kumta haba ki la pynïap ïa ki, kita ki nongap bad ki rangbah ki la pret ïa ki shabar. Nangta ki la leit rung sha ka kamra ka bashapoh eh jong ka ïingblei u Baal.
Ki la sei shabar ïa u rishot uba hapoh ka ïing u Baal bad ki la thang ïa u.
Ynda ki la pynlko pom ïa u rishot bad ïa ka ïing u Baal, ki la pynlong paiñkhana ïa ka haduh kane ka sngi.
Kumta u Jehu u la pynduh pyndam ïa u Baal na Israel.
La kumta ruh u Jehu um shym kynriah na ki kam bymman u Jeroboam u khun u Nebat, shaphang ki khun masi ksiar ha Bethel bad ha Dan, kiba la pynlong ïa ki Israel ban leh bymman.

Te u Trai U la ong ha u Jehu, “Namarba phi la leh bha ïa kata kaba nga ñiew ka badei, bad phi la leh ïa ka ïing u Ahab kumba don ha ka dohnud jong Nga, ki khun jong phi kin sa shong halor ka khet Israel haduh ka pateng ka basaw.”
Hynrei u Jehu um shym sumar ban ïaid katkum ka aiñ u Trai u Blei ki Israel da ka dohnud jong u baroh. Um shym phai na ki kam bymman u Jeroboam, kiba la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh kumjuh.
Ha kito ki sngi u Trai U la sdang ban ot dkhot ïa ka Israel. U Hazael u la jop ïa ki Israel kylleng sawdong ka ri jong ki:
naduh Jordan shaphang mihngi, baroh ka ri Gilead, ka ri ki Gad, ki Reuben bad ki Manasse, naduh Aroer kaba markhap ka them jong ka Arnon, kynthup ka Gilead bad Bashan.
Ïa kiwei pat ki kam u Jehu, ïa ki jingleh jong u baroh bad ïa ka bor bah jong u, la thoh ha ki Kitab Jynthoh kynmaw jong ki syiem Israel.
Kumta u Jehu u la thiah bad ki kpa jong u bad ki la tep ïa u ha Samaria. U khun jong u u Jehoahas u la synshar nadien jong u.
Ka por ba u Jehu u la synshar halor ki Israel ha Samaria ka la long arphew phra snem.
Ka la jia ba haba ka Athalia ka kmie u Ahazia ka la ïohi ba u khun jong ka u la ïap, shisyndon ka la pynïap noh ïa ka jait syiem baroh kawei.

Hynrei ka Jehosheba, ka khun u syiem Joram, shipara bad u Ahazia, ka la shim tuh ïa u Jehoash u khun u Ahazia napdeng ki khun u syiem ïa kiba yn sa pynïap, bad ka la buh ïa u bad ka aïa ha kawei ka kamra thiah. Kumta ka la buhrieh ïa u na ka Athalia bad ym shym ïoh pynïap ïa u.
Kumba hynriew snem u la rieh ha ka tempyl u Trai katba dang synshar ka Athalia halor ka ri.

Hynrei ha ka snem ka bahynñiew u Jehoïada u la phah wan ïa ki rangbah pyrton jong ki Karian bad jong ki nongap karod bad u la ïalam ïa ki sha ka tempyl u Trai. U la ïateh jutang bad ki, u da phah smai artat, bad u la pyni ha ki ïa u khun jong u syiem.
U la hukum ïa ki, “Phin leh kumne na ka kynhun kaba dei ap ha ka sabath, ka bynta ka balai kan ap ïa ka ïing syiem;
kawei pat ka balai kan ap ha ka khyrdop Zur, bad ka bynta ka bakhatduh kan don ha ka khyrdop kaba shadien ki nongap karod.
Ki ar kynhun na phi kiba lait jingap ha ka sabath, kin ap ïa ka tempyl u Trai na ka bynta u syiem.
Kumta phin ap tawiar ïa u syiem, uwei pa uwei la ki tiar thma ha ka kti. Kat ïa uba wan tur sha jaka ap, dei ban pynïap. Sah bad u syiem kat shaba u leit.”

Ki rangbah pyrton ki la leh kumba hukum u lyngdoh Jehoïada. Uwei pa uwei u la wan ïalam ïa la ki briew ïa kito kiba lait jingap ha ka sabath bad ïa kiba dei ban ap ha ka sabath ruh, bad ki la wan sha u lyngdoh Jehoïada.
U lyngdoh U la ai ha ki rangbah pyrton ïa ki sum bad ki stieh u syiem Dabid kiba don ha ka tempyl u Trai.
Ki nongap ki la ïeng, uwei pa uwei la ka atiar ka atiar ha ka kti, naduh ka dong kaba shathie haduh ka dong kaba shatei, sawdong ka duwan bad ka tempyl.

Nangta u Jehoïada u la pynmih ïa u khun u syiem, u la pynphong pansngiat ïa u, u la ai ha u ïa ka dak syiem bad u sa pynsleh ïa u kum u syiem. Hangta ki la kynhoi syiem ïa u bad ki la ïathap kti, ki pyrta, “To u syiem un im slem!”
Haba ka Athalia ka la ïohsngew ïa ka jingpyrta ki nongap bad ki paidbah, ka la leit sha ka tempyl haba don ki paidbah.

Ka la ïohi ïa u syiem ba u ïeng katkum ka dustur, ha syndah u rishot, ïa ki rangbah pyrton bad ki nongput turoi hajan u syiem, bad ïa ki paidbah ka ri baroh ba ki ïarisa bad ïaput turoi. Hangta ka Athalia ka la kad ïa la ki jaiñ bad ka la pyrta, “La shet kylla, la shet kylla!”
Te u lyngdoh Jehoïada u la hukum ïa ki rangbah nongïalam jong ki pyrton, “Sei ïa ka na jynker; pynïap ïa uno uno uba bud ïa ka.” U lyngdoh u la ong, “Wat pynïap ïa ka hapoh ka tempyl u Trai.”
Kumta ki la kem ïa ka. Ka la leit na lynti rung ki kulai sha ïing syiem bad ki la pynïap ïa ka hangta.
Te u Jehoïada u la pynlong ka jingïateh jutang hapdeng u Trai, u syiem bad ki paidbah, ba ki dei ban long ki paid u Trai; kumjuh ruh hapdeng u syiem bad u paidbah.

Hadien kata u paidbah baroh u la leit sha ka ïingblei u Baal bad ki la pynpra ïa ka. Ki la pynlwet ïa ki duwan bad ki dur jong u bad ki la pynïap ïa u Mattan u lyngdoh u Baal hakhmat ki duwan. U lyngdoh u la buh ki nongap phira ïa ka tempyl u Trai.

Nangta u la shim ïa ki rangbah pyrton, ïa ki Karian, ïa ki nongap phira bad ïa ki paidbah baroh bad u la phah ïa ki ban ïalam ïa u syiem na tempyl lyngba ka khyrdop ki Santari shaduh ïing syiem. Kumta u la shong halor ka khet ki syiem.
U paidbah baroh jong ka ri u la shadkmen bad ka nongbah ka la suk jai ynda la pynïap ïa ka Athalia ha ïing u syiem.
U Jehoash u dang hynñiew snem ka ryta haba u la sdang ban synshar.
U Jehoash u la sdang ban synshar ha ka snem ka bahynñiew jong u Jehu bad u la synshar sawphew snem ha Jerusalem. Ka kmie jong u ka kyrteng ka Zibia kaba na Beersheba.
U Jehoash u la leh bha hakhmat u Trai baroh ki sngi jong u namar u lyngdoh Jehoïada u la hikai ïa u.
La katta ruh ym shym la weng noh ïa ki duwan halor lum, bad ki paidbah ki dang leit kñia bad thang jyniwbih ha kine ki duwan halor lum.

U Jehoash u la ong ha ki lyngdoh, “Ïa ki peisa tyngka ba wan rah ha ka tempyl u Trai na ka bynta ki jingthmu ki bakhuid, ïa ka peisa tyngka na ka musur ïa ki briew shimet shimet—ka peisa tyngka khrong halor ki briew—bad ïa ka peisa tyngka ba u briew u wan ai da la ka mon sngewbha ha ka tempyl u Trai,
ieh kin shim ki lyngdoh, uwei pa uwei na la ki lok ki jor. Pynban ki dei ban maramot ïa ka tempyl kat haba donkam.”
Hynrei haduh ka snem ba arphewlai naduh ba long syiem u Johoash, ki lyngdoh kim pat maramot satia ïa ka tempyl.

Kumta u syiem Jehoash u la phah khot ïa u lyngdoh Jehoïada bad ïa kiwei pat ki lyngdoh, bad u la ong ha ki, “Balei phim ju maramot satia ïa ka tempyl? Naduh mynta wat shim peisa tyngka shuh na ki lok ki jor jong phi, hynrei phi dei ban pynphai ïa ki ban maramot ïa ka tempyl.”
Ki lyngdoh ki la mynjur ba kim dei ban shim peisa tyngka na ki paidbah bad ba kim dei shuh ma ki kiban maramot ïa ka tempyl.

Te u lyngdoh Jehoïada u la shim kawei ka synduk bad ynda u la pong thliew ha ka jyntap, u la buh ïa ka ha syndah ka duwan na ka dong ba sha kamon haba rung ha tempyl. Ki lyngdoh kiba ap ha tyngkong ki thep hapoh jong ka ïa ka peisa tyngka baroh ba wan rah ha ka tempyl u Trai.
Haba ki ïohi ba ka peisa ha ka synduk ka la bun, u nongthoh u syiem bad u lyngdoh rangbah ki wan ñiew bad ki teh ha ki muna ïa ka peisa kaba don ha ka tempyl u Trai.
Ynda la dep thew ïa kane ka peisa, ki ai ïa ka ha ki rangbah nongpeit ïa ka ïing u Trai. Sa kine pat ki siew bainong da ka ïa ki misteri bad ki nongtei kiba trei ïa ka ïing u Trai,
ïa ki misteri maw bad ki nongshniah maw bad ki thied dieng bad maw shtah ban maramot ïa ka ïing u Trai, bad ki pynlut ha ki kam maramot kiba kumno kumno ïa ka ïing u Trai.
Hynrei na kane ka peisa ba wan rah ha ka ïing u Trai ym shym thaw dabor rupa, jynpynlip ding, khuri, turoi ne kino kino ki khiew ksiar ne rupa na ka bynta ka ïing u Trai;
namar ïa kata ka peisa la ai ïa ki nongtrei kiba maramot ïa ka ïing u Trai.
Kim shym pan jingkheiñ jingdiah ruh na kiba ai peisa ban siew ïa ki nongtrei, namar ba ki leh hok.
Ïa ka peisa na ki jynkñia pynbiang ïa ka pop ne kam bakla, ym shym rah ha ka tempyl u Trai. Kane ka dei ka jong ki lyngdoh.
Ha kata ka por, u Hazael syiem Siria u la hiar thma ïa ka Gath bad u la jop ïa ka. Haba u la pynkhreh ban ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem,

u Jehoash syiem Juda u la shim ïa ki jynai bakhuid baroh ba la pynkyntang ki kpa tymmen jong u, u Jehoshaphat, u Jehoram, u Ahazia, ki syiem Juda, wat ïa la ki jong ki jynaiti kyntang bad ïa ka ksiar baroh katba shem ha ki jingkynshew ka ïing u Trai bad ka ïing u syiem, bad u la phah ïa ki sha u Hazael syiem Siria. Bad u Hazael u la leit noh na Jerusalem.
Ïa kiwei pat ki kam u Jehoash bad ïa ki jingleh jong u baroh, la thoh ha ka Kitab Jynthoh kynmaw ki Syiem Juda.
Ki nongbud jong u ki la ïasylla bad ki la pynïap ïa u Johoash ha Beth-millo, ha ka lynti kaba leit hiar sha Zilla.

Dei u Jozakar u khun u Shimeath bad u Jehosabad u khun u Shomer, kiba la pynïap ïa u. Ki la tep ïa u ryngkat bad ki kpa tymmen jong u ha ka Nongbah u Dabid, bad u Amazia u khun jong u u la synshar hadien jong u.
Ha ka snem ba-arphewlai jong ka jingsynshar u Jehoash u khun u Ahazia syiem Juda, u Jehoahas u khun u Jehu u la sdang ban synshar halor ki Israel ha Samaria, bad u la synshar khathynñiew snem.
U la leh tang ki kam bymman suda hakhmat u Trai, bad u la pyrthuh ïa ki kam bymman u Jeroboam u khun u Nebat, kiba la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh kumjuh. Um shym kynriah na ki.
U Trai U la khie bitar ïa ki Israel bad U la aiti ïa ki khru shi khru ha u Hazael syiem Siria bad ha u Ben-Hadad khun u Hazael.
Te u Jehoahas u la kyrpad ïa u Trai bad u Trai U la shah shkor ïa u namar U la ïohi kumno u syiem Siria u la leh beiñ sat ïa ki Israel.
U Trai U la ai u nongpyllait ïa ki Israel, bad kumta ki la lait na ka kti ki Siria. Hangta ki Israel ki la ïoh shongsuk shongsaiñ kum mynshuwa.
La kumta ruh kim shym kynriah na ki kam bymman kiba ka ïing u Jeroboam ka la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh. Ki la marmlien ïa ki. Ki rishot blei Ashera ruh ki dang sah ha Samaria.

U Jehoahas um shym don pyrton shuh nalor sanphew ngut ki pyrton kulai, shiphew tylli ki kali bad shiphew hajar ki pyrton kjat. U syiem Siria u la pynduh khoit ïa ki bad u la ïuh roit ïa ki la kum ïa u khyndew shoh kew.
Ïa kiwei pat ki kam u Jehoahas, ïa ki jingleh jong u bad ïa ka jingkhlaiñ bor jong u, la thoh ha ka Kitab Jynthoh kynmaw jong ki Syiem Israel.
U Jehoahas u la ïoh thiah bad ki kpa tymmen jong u, bad ki la tep ïa u ha Samaria. U khun jong u u Joash u la synshar nadien jong u.
Ha ka snem ka balaiphew hynñiew jong ka jingsynshar u Jehoash syiem Juda, u Joash khun u Jehoahas u la sdang ban synshar halor ki Israel ha Samaria, bad u la synshar khathynriew snem.
Une ruh u leh tang ki kam bymman hakhmat u Trai. Um shym kynriah na ki jingleh bymman kiba u Jeroboam u khun u Nebat u la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh, hynrei u la marmlien ha ki.
Ïa kiwei pat ki kam u Joash, ïa ki jingleh jong u baroh, bad ïa ka jingdukhi jong u kumno u la ïaleh ïa u Amazia syiem Juda, la thoh ha ka Kitab Jynthoh kynmaw jong ki Syiem Israel.
U Joash u la ïoh thiah bad ki kpa tymmen jong u, bad u Jeroboam u la shong halor ka khet jong u. Ïa u Joash la tep ha Samaria bad ki syiem Israel.

Ka la jia ba haba u Elisha u la ïoh pang da ka jingpang ba u la ïap, u Joash syiem Israel u la leit peit ïa u, bad da kaba ïam u la pyrta, “Ko pa jong nga! Ko pa jong nga! U nongïalam ka Israel bad u nongda jong ka!”
Te u Elisha u la ong ha u, “Shim ka ryntieh bad ki khnam”; u la shim ka ryntieh bad ki khnam.
Nangta u la ong ha u syiem Israel, “Wiat ïa ka ryntieh”; bad u la wiat ïa ka. U Elisha u la buh ïa la ki kti ha ki kti u syiem.

U la ong, “Plie ïa ka khalki kaba shaphang mihngi”, bad u la plie ïa ka. Te u Elisha u la ong, “Siat!” bad u la siat. Bad u la ong, “U khnam ka jingjop u Trai, u khnam ka jingjop ïa ki Siria. Naba phin sa ïaleh ïa ki Siria ha Aphek haduh ba yn da jop thiaw ïa ki.”
Te u la ong, “Shim ïa ki khnam”, bad u shim ïa ki. U la ong ha u syiem Israel “Shoh da ki ïa ka khyndew,” bad u la shoh lai sien, nangta u sangeh.

Hangta u briew jong u Blei u la bitar bad u la ong, “Phi la dei ban shoh san wat hynriew wat, te kumta phin jin da la pom ïa ki Siria haduh ba kin da duh da dam khoit. Hynrei mynta phin jop ïa ki Siria tang lai wat.”
U Elisha u la ïap, bad ki la tep ïa u. Ka la jia ba ki kynhun Moab ki shait wan lute ïa ka ri ha ka por pyrem man ka snem.

Shisien katba ki dang ïaleit tep ïa u briew, la wan mih shi kynhun ki nonglute, bad ïa uta u briew la bret ha ka jyntep u Elisha. Uta u briew u tang shu dei ha ki shyieng u Elisha, u la khie-im bad u la ïeng da la ki kjat.
U Hazael syiem Siria u la bánbeiñ ïa ki Israel baroh shilynter ki sngi u Jehoahas.

Hynrei u Trai U la leh sbun bad U la sngewsynei ïa ki, kumta U la phai sha ki namar U la don ka jutang bad u Abraham, u Isaak, bad u Jakob ba Un ym pynduh pyndam ïa ki; te haduh mynta Um shym bret ïa ki nakhmat jong U.
Ynda la ïap u Hazael syiem Siria, u khun jong u u Ben-Hadad u la long syiem hadien jong u.

Te u Joash u khun u Jehoahas u la ïoh knieh biang na u Ben-Hadad u khun u Hazael ïa ki shnong baroh kiba u la jop da ka thma ïa u kpa jong u u Jehoahas. U Joash u la jop ïa u lai wat bad u la ïoh biang ïa ki shnong Israel.
Ha ka snem ka ba-ar jong ka jingsynshar u Joash u khun u Jehoahas, syiem Israel, u Amazia khun u Jehoash, syiem Juda, u la sdang ban synshar.
U la don arphew san snem ka ryta mynba u la sdang ban synshar, bad u la synshar arphew khyndai snem ha Jerusalem. Ka kmie jong u ka kyrteng ka Jehoaddin kaba na Jerusalem.
U la leh bha hakhmat u Trai, hynrei um ïakot bad u Dabid u kpa tymmen jong u. U la shu pyrthuh ha kiei kiei baroh ïa kaba leh u Jehoash u kpa jong u.
Ym shym weng ïa ki duwan halor lum, bad ki briew ruh ki dang leit kñia leit thang dhup ha kine ki duwan halor lum.
U tang shu ïoh bat skhem ïa ka bor syiem ha la ka kti, u la pynïap ïa ki nongbud jong kiba la pynïap ïa u syiem, u kpa jong u.

Hynrei um shym pynïap ïa ki khun jong ki nongpynïap, ban kohnguh ïa kaba la thoh ha ka kitab jong ka aiñ u Moses, ha kaba u Trai U la hukum, “Ïa ki kpa ym dei ban pynïap na ka bynta ki khun, ne ïa ki khun ym dei ban pynïap na ka bynta ki kpa. Man la u briew un ïap tang na ka bynta ka pop lajong.”
U la pynïap shiphew hajar ngut ki Edom ha ka Them Mluh bad u la jop ïa ka Zela da ka thma. U la ai kyrteng Joktheel ïa ka, haduh mynta mynne.
Te u Amazia u la phah ki nongrah khubor sha u Joash u khun u Jehoahas u khun u Jehu, u syiem Israel, u ong, “Ale wan ïakynduh markhmat.”

U Joash syiem Israel pat u la phah ktien sha u Amazia syiem Juda, “U diengsoh byrthit na Lebanon u la phah ktien sha u dieng kedar ha Lebanon, u ong, ‘Pynïashong noh ïa ka khun jong phi bad u khun jong nga’; hynrei uwei u mrad khlaw uba ïaid nangta u la kyrdem ïa u diengsoh byrthit.

Phi la sngewmeng ka dohnud namarba phi la ïuh roit ïa ka Edom. To pynjah kwah da kane ka burom, bad shong khop ha la ïing. Balei phin kynroi jingsniew ïoh phi khyllem, ym tang ma phi, ka Juda ruh bad phi?”
Hynrei u Amazia um sngap. Kumta u Joash syiem Israel u la leit tur. Ma u bad u Amazia syiem Juda ki la ïakynduh markhmat da ka thma ha Beth-shemesh, ka khyndew Juda.
Ki Juda ki la shah jop ha ki Israel bad man la u briew u la phet ïap sha la ïing.

U Joash syiem Israel u la ïoh kem koidi ïa u Amazia syiem Juda, u khun u Jehoash u khun u Ahazia, ha Beth-shemesh. Nangta u la wan sha Jerusalem bad la pyntwa ïa ka kynroh Jerusalem kumba sawspah pruh, naduh Khyrdop Ephraim haduh Khyrdop Dong.
U la knieh lut ïa ka ksiar bad rupa, ïa ki khiew ki pliang kiba ha ka tempyl u Trai bad ha ki jaka kynshew jong ka ïing syiem. Wat ïa ki koidi-jamin ruh u la kem, nangta u la wan phai sha Samaria.
Ïa kiwei pat ki kam u Joash bad ïa ka borbah jong u, kumno u la ïaleh thma ïa u Amazia syiem Juda, la thoh ha ka Kitab Jynthoh kynmaw jong ki Syiem Israel.
U Joash u la ïoh thiah bad ki kpa tymmen jong u bad la tep ïa u ha Samaria bad ki syiem Israel. U Jeroboam, u khun jong u, u la synshar hadien jong u.
U Amazia khun u Jehoash, syiem Juda, u la im sa khatsan snem hadien ka jingïap u Joash, u khun u Jehoahas, syiem Israel.
Ïa kiwei pat ki kam u Amazia la thoh ha ka Kitab Jynthoh kynmaw jong ki Syiem Juda.
Te la don kiba ïasylla pyrshah ïa u ha Jerusalem bad u la phet sha Lakhish. Hynrei ki la phah briew ban bud ïa u shata bad ki la pynïap ïa u hangta.
Ki la pynkit ïa u da ki kulai, bad ïa u la tep ha Jerusalem ryngkat bad ki kpa tymmen jong u ha ka Nongbah u Dabid.
Ki paidbah baroh ki la shim ïa u Azaria, uba dang khathynriew snem ka ryta, bad ki la thung syiem ïa u ban bud pateng ïa la u kpa, u Amazia.
Dei u Azaria uba la tei biang ïa ka Elath bad la pynïoh biang ïa ka ha Juda, ynda u syiem Amazia u la ïoh thiah bad ki kpa tymmen jong u.
Ha ka snem ka bakhatsan jong ka jinglong syiem u Amazia u khun u Jehoash, syiem Juda, u Jeroboam khun u Joash, syiem Israel, u la sdang ban synshar ha Samaria, bad u la synshar sawphew wei snem.
U la leh tang ka jingbymman suda hakhmat u Trai bad um shym kynriah na ki pop u Jeroboam u khun u Nebat, kiba la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh bymman.

U la pynbeit ïa ki pud sawdong ka Israel naduh ka kpait Hamath shaduh ka Duriaw Araba, kumba la kren u Trai u Blei u Israel da u shakri jong U u Jona, u khun u Amittai, u nongïathuhlypa uba na Gath-hepher.
U Trai U la ïohi ïa ka jinglanot ka bakhraw jong ki Israel. Ym don mano mano uba lait, lane u mraw ne u balaitluid, bad ym don ruh mano mano uban ïarap ïa ki Israel.
Hynrei u Trai Um shym la rai ban pyndam ïa ka kyrteng Israel na sla pyrthei. Kumta U la pyllait im ïa ki da ka kti u Jeroboam u khun u Joash.

Ïa kiwei pat ki kam u Jeroboam, ïa ki jingleh jong u baroh, bad ïa ka borbah jong u, kumno u la pynïoh biang ha ki Israel ïa ka Damaskus bad ka Hamath kaba dei ka jong ki Juda, la thoh ha ka Kitab Jynthoh kynmaw ki Syiem Israel.
U Jeroboam u la ïoh thiah bad ki kpa tymmen jong u, ki syiem Israel, bad u Zekharia u khun jong u u la synshar hadien jong u.
Ha ka snem ka ba-arphew hynñiew jong ka jingsynshar u Jeroboam syiem Israel, u Azaria u khun u Amazia, syiem Juda, u la sdang ban synshar.
U dang khathynriew snem ka ryta haba u la sdang ban synshar, bad u la synshar sanphew ar snem ha Jerusalem. Ka kmie jong u ka kyrteng ka Jekolia, kaba na Jerusalem.
U la leh bha hakhmat u Trai, kumba la leh u kpa jong u u Amazia.
La kumta ruh ïa ki duwan halor lum ym shym la weng noh bad ki paidbah ki dang kñia bad dang thang dhup ha kine ki duwan halor lum.

Te u Trai U la sympat ïa u syiem bad u la ïoh ka jingpang ’ñiangthohlieh haduh ka sngi jingïap. U la shong ha ka ïing ka bakyrpang, bad u Jotham u khun jong u u la peit ïa ka ïing syiem bad u la pynïaid ïa u paidbah ka ri.
Ïa kiwei pat ki kam u Azaria, bad ïa ki jingleh jong u baroh, la thoh ha ka Kitab Jynthoh kynmaw jong ki Syiem Juda.
Te u Azaria u la ïoh thiah bad ki kpa tymmen jong u, bad ki la tep ïa u ryngkat bad ki ha ka Nongbah u Dabid. U Jotham u khun jong u u la synshar hadien jong u.
Ha ka snem ka balaiphew phra jong ka jingsynshar u Azaria syiem Juda, u Zekharia u khun u Jeroboam u la synshar hynriew bnai halor ki Israel ha Samaria.
U la leh bymman hakhmat u Trai kumba la leh ki kpa tymmen jong u. Um shym kynriah na ki kam bymman u Jeroboam u khun u Nebat kiba la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh kumjuh.
U Shallum u khun u Jabesh u la sylla pyrshah ïa u, u la pynïap ïa u ha Ibleam, bad u la synshar hadien jong u.
Ïa kiwei pat ki kam u Zekharia la thoh ha ka Kitab Jynthoh kynmaw ki Syiem Israel.
(Kumta ka la urlong ka jingkular ba u Trai U la ai ha u Jehu, “Ki khun jong phi kin sa shong halor ka khet Israel haduh ka pateng ka basaw.”
U Shallum u khun u Jabesh u la sdang ban synshar ha ka snem ka balaiphew khyndai jong u Ussia syiem Juda, bad u la synshar shibnai ha Samaria.
Te u Menahem u khun u Gadi u la wan kiew na Tirza haduh ban da poi ha Samaria bad u la pynïap ïa u Shallum u khun u Jabesh ha Samaria, nangta u sa synshar hadien jong u.
Ïa kiwei pat ki kam jong u Shallum bad ïa ka jingsylla jong u, la thoh ha ka Kitab Jynthoh kynmaw jong ki Syiem Israel.

Ha kata ka por, u Menahem u la pynjot thiaw ïa ka Tappua, u da pynïap baroh kat kiba don ha ka, baroh shi ilaka naduh Tirza shaneng. Namarba kim treh plie ïa ka shnong, u la pynjot ïa ka bad u la tar arliang ïa ki kynthei armet baroh.
Ha ka snem ka balaiphew khyndai jong ka jingsynshar u Azaria syiem Juda, u Menahem u khun u Gadi u la sdang ban synshar halor ki Israel, bad u la synshar shiphew snem ha Samaria.
U la leh bymman hakhmat u Trai. Um shym kynriah na ki kam bymman baroh jong u Jeroboam u khun u Nebat, kiba la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh bymman.
U Pul, syiem Assiria, u la hiar thma ïa ka ri, bad u Menahem u la ai shihajar talen ka rupa ïa u Pul ba un dup ïarap ïa u ban pynskhem ïa ka bor syiem jong u.

U Menahem u la ïoh tyngka ban ai ïa u syiem Assiria da kaba pynbor ïa ki bariewspah ha ka ri ban ïa ai mar sanphew shekel ka rupa uwei uwei. Kumta u syiem Assiria u la leit noh, bad um shym sah ha ka ri.
Ïa kiwei pat ki kam u Menahem, bad ïa ki jingleh jong u baroh, la thoh ha ka Kitab Jynthoh kynmaw jong ki Syiem Israel.
U Menahem u la ïoh thiah bad ki kpa tymmen jong u, bad u Pekahia u khun jong u u la synshar hadien jong u.
Ha ka snem ka basanphew jong ka jingsynshar u Azaria syiem Juda, u Pekahia u khun u Menahem u la sdang ban synshar halor ki Israel ha Samaria, bad u la synshar ar snem.
U la leh bymman hakhmat u Trai. Um shym kynriah na ki kam bymman u Jeroboam u khun u Nebat, kiba la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh bymman.

Te u Peka, u rangbah pyrton jong u, u khun u Remalia, u la ïasylla bad sanphew ngut ki nong Gilead, bad u la pynïap ïa u ha Samaria, hapoh ka kut jong ka ïing syiem. Ynda u la pynïap ïa u, u la synshar hadien jong u.
Ïa kiwei pat ki kam u Pekahia, bad ïa ki jingleh jong u, la thoh ha ka Kitab Jynthoh kynmaw jong ki Syiem Israel.
Ha ka snem ka basanphew ar jong ka jingsynshar u Azaria syiem Juda, u Peka u khun u Remalia u la sdang ban synshar halor ki Israel ha Samaria. U la synshar arphew snem.
U la leh bymman hakhmat u Trai, bad um shym kynriah satia na ki kam bymman u Jeroboam u khun u Nebat, kiba la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh bymman.

Ha ki sngi u Peka syiem Israel, u Tiglath-Pileser syiem Assiria u la wan hiar thma bad u la jop ïa ka Ijon, ka Abel-beth-Maaka, ka Janoa, ka Kedesh, ka Hazor, ka Gilead, bad ka Galilea, baroh kawei ka Naphtali, bad u la ring mraw ïa ki briew sha Assiria.

Te u Hoshea, u khun u Ela u la sylla pyrshah ïa u Peka u khun u Remalia, bad u la pynïap ïa u. Ynda u la pynïap ïa u, u la synshar hadien jong u ha ka snem ka ba-arphew jong ka jingsynshar u Jotham u khun u Ussia.
Ïa kiwei pat ki kam u Peka, bad ïa ki jingleh jong u baroh, la thoh ha ka Kitab Jynthoh kynmaw jong ki Syiem Israel.
Ha ka snem ka ba-ar jong ka jingsynshar u Peka u khun u Remalia, syiem Israel, u Jotham u khun u Ussia, syiem Juda, u la sdang ban synshar.
U la don arphew san snem ka ryta haba u la sdang ban synshar, bad u la synshar khathynriew snem ha Jerusalem. Ka kyrteng ka kmie jong u ka Jerusha, ka khun u Zadok.
U la leh bha hakhmat u Trai, kumba la leh u Ussia u kpa jong u.
La kumta ruh, ïa ki duwan halor lum ym shym weng noh. Ki paidbah ki dang ïaileit ban kñia bad ban thang dhup ha kita ki duwan halor lum. Dei ma u uba la tei ïa ka khyrdop kaba shaneng jong ka tempyl.
Ïa kiwei pat ki kam u Jotham bad ïa ki jingleh jong u baroh, la thoh ha ka Kitab Jynthoh kynmaw jong ki Syiem Juda.
Dei ha kito ki sngi ba u Trai U la phah nyngkong ïa u Resin syiem Siria bad ïa u Peka u khun u Remalia pyrshah ka Juda.
U Jotham u la thiah bad ki kpa tymmen jong u bad ïa u la tep ryngkat bad ki kpa tymmen jong u ha ka Nongbah u Dabid u kpa jong u. U Ahas u khun jong u u la synshar hadien jong u.
Ha ka snem ka bakhathynñiew jong ka jingsynshar u Peka u khun u Remalia, u Ahas u khun u Jotham, syiem Juda u la sdang ban synshar.
U Ahas u la don arphew snem ka ryta haba u la sdang ban synshar, bad u la synshar khathynriew snem ha Jerusalem. Um shym leh bha satia hakhmat u Trai u Blei jong u kumba leh u Dabid u kpa jong u.
U la pyrthuh ïa ka akor im ki syiem Israel. U la thang wat ïa la u khun kum u jynkñia, ban bud ïa ki jingleh ki ba-isaitmet jong kito ki jait bynriew kiba u Trai U la beh krad hakhmat ki paid Israel.
U la kñia bad u la thang jyniwbih ha ki duwan kiba ha ki jaka kynjang, ha ki jaka lum bad kat haba don dieng jyrngam.
Dei ha ka por jong u ba u Resin syiem Siria bad u Peka u khun u Remalia, syiem Israel, ki la wan hiar thma ïa ka Jerusalem. Ki la kerkut ïa u Ahas, hynrei kim shym lah ban jop ïa u.
Ha kata ka por u syiem Edom u la ïoh biang na ka bynta ka Edom ïa ka Elath, bad u la beh ïa ki nong Juda nangta. Ki nong Edom ki la wan shong ha Elath bad ki dang don haduh mynta mynne.

Kumta u Ahas u la phah nongrah khubor sha u Tiglath-Pileser syiem Assiria, u ong, “Nga long u shakri bad u khun jong phi. Ale pyllait ïa nga na ki kti u syiem Siria bad u syiem Israel, kiba ïaleh ïa nga.”
U Ahas u la shim katba don ka rupa bad ka ksiar ha ka tempyl u Trai bad ha ïing syiem, bad u la phah ai sngewbha ïa ki ha u syiem Assiria.
U syiem Assiria u la shah shkor ïa u bad u la hiar thma ïa ka Damaskus. U la jop ïa ka u la ring ïa ki paid briew sha Kir bad u la pynïap ïa u Resin.

Te ka la jia ba u syiem Ahas u la leit sha Damaskus ban ïakynduh ïa u Tiglath-Pileser syiem Assiria, bad u la ïohi ïa ka duwan kaba don ha Damaskus. Kumta u syiem Ahas u la phah ïa ka nuksa jong ka duwan sha u lyngdoh Uria lem bad ïa ka rukom shna jong ka nadong shadong.
U lyngdoh Uria u la tei ïa ka duwan thik kumba u syiem Ahas u la phah na Damaskus. Kumta u lyngdoh Uria u la pyndep ïa ka shuwa ban wan phai u syiem Ahas nangta.
Haba u syiem u la wan phai na Damaskus, u la leit peit ïa ka duwan. Ynda u la leit hajan ka duwan, u la kiew sha ka,
nangta u la tyrwa jynkñia thang bad jynkñia kpu, u la suit la shor da ka jyntyrwa jyndih bad u la synreit da ka snam jong ka jyntyrwa ïabha ïamiat halor ka duwan.

U la weng noh ïa ka duwan rnong kaba ju don hakhmat u Trai nakhmat ka tempyl—kata na ka jaka hapdeng ka duwan jong u bad ka tempyl u Trai—bad u la buh ïa ka ha ka dong kaba shaneng ka duwan bathymmai.

U syiem Ahas u la ai kane ka hukum ïa u lyngdoh Uria, “Halor ka duwan ka baheh, phin thang ïa ka jynkñia mynstep, ïa ka jyntyrwa kpu kaba janmiet, ïa ka jynkñia bad ka jyntyrwa kpu u syiem, ïa ki jyntyrwa thang, ki jyntyrwa kpu bad ki jynsuit jynshor ki paidbah. Phi dei ruh ban synreit halor jong ka ïa ka snam ki jyntyrwa thang bad ki jynkñia baroh phar. Hynrei ka duwan rnong kan sah na ka bynta jong nga ban wad jingtip.”
U lyngdoh Uria u la leh thik kumba u syiem Ahas u la ai hukum.

Te u syiem Ahas u la pynpra ïa ki jynpynïeng ba don shaka bad u la weng noh ïa ka dabor heh na ki. U la loit noh ïa ka dabor rnong na ki masi kiba kyrshan ïa ka, bad u la pynshong ïa ka ha ka tbian ba siang da ki maw.
Kum ka jingsngew burom ïa u syiem Assiria, u la weng noh na ka tempyl u Trai ïa ka rynsan khet ïa kaba la tei hangta, bad ïa ka khyrdop rung u syiem na shabar.
Ïa kiwei pat ki kam u Ahas la thoh ka Kitab Jynthoh kynmaw ki Syiem Juda.
U Ahas u la ïohthiah bad ki kpa tymmen jong u, bad ïa u la tep lang bad ki kpa tymmen jong u ha ka Nongbah u Dabid. U Hezekia u khun jong u u la synshar hadien jong u.
Ha ka snem ka bakhat-ar jong ka jingsynshar u Ahas syiem Juda, u Hoshea, u khun u Ela, u la sdang ban synshar halor ki Israel ha Samaria. U la synshar khyndai snem.
U la leh bymman hakhmat u Trai, la shisha ym da dei eh kum kiwei pat ki syiem Israel kiba mynshuwa jong u.
U Shalmaneser syiem Assiria u la ïaleh thma ïa u, bad u Hoshea u la hap siew khajna kum u syiem raïot.

Hynrei u syiem Assiria u la lap ïa ka jingshet kylla jong u, namar u Hoshea u la phah ki nonglam ktien sha u So syiem Ijipt, bad um siew khajna shuh ha u syiem Assiria kumba u ju leh man ka snem. Kumta u syiem Assiria u la khum ïa u da ki kynjri bad u la set hapoh byndi.
U syiem Assiria u la hiar thma ïa ka ri baroh kawei bad ynda u la poi ha Samaria, u la kerkut ïa ka kumba lai snem.

Ha ka snem ka bakhyndai jong ka jinglong syiem u Hoshea, u syiem Assiria u la jop ïa ka Samaria. U la ring mraw ïa ki Israel sha Assiria bad u la pynshong ïa ki ha Hala, harud ka wah Habor kaba ha Gozan, bad ha ki shnong Mid.

Ka la jia kumne namarba ki paidbah Israel ki la leh bymman pyrshah u Trai u Blei jong ki Uba la wan ïalam ïa ki na Ijipt, na ka jingsynshar u Pharo, u syiem Ijipt. Ki la mane pynban ïa kiwei pat ki blei
bad ki la bud ïa ki riti jong kito ki jait bynriew kiba u Trai U la beh nakhmat ki Israel, bad dei ki syiem Israel hi kiba la pynrung ïa ki.
